**Join Dennis Speed and Bill Jones tonight!

All eyes yesterday were on Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, where Ukrainian and American representatives met and agreed to a 30-day ceasefire in Ukraine.
Today, President Trump’s Middle East envoy Steve Witkoff will meet with Russian President Vladimir Putin, assuredly to discuss the proposal. In a press conference today with Belarus President Alexander Lukashenko, Putin made clear that he was thankful for the efforts of President Trump, along with the governments of China, Brazil, India, and South Africa for engaging in constructive dialogue to resolve the senseless killing in Ukraine. He also said that he was in favor of a ceasefire, as long as it led to a long-term settlement of the crisis. There must be guarantees, Putin said, on how the 30-day ceasefire will function. Will Ukraine take this as an opportunity to remobilize? How will violations to the agreement be handled? Who will be blamed if violations occur?
Clearly, President Putin understands the strategic implications of what President Trump has set into motion, but is adamant that Russia’s long-term security concerns must be addressed. The solution to the NATO-Russia war, the genocide in Southwest Asia, and other global conflicts relies on principles of statecraft, not simply good intentions. Those principles have been provided by Helga Zepp-LaRouche in her call for a new, security and development architecture and the Ten Principles which provides a basis for how that can take shape.
We are now just a little bit over a month away from the 250th anniversary of the Battles of Lexington and Concord, which kicked off the American Revolution. Just a day before, Paul Revere took his famous ride to begin mobilizing colonial militiamen against the British redcoats. The realization of a new, security and development architecture depends on reviving those American principles of statecraft uniquely defined by George Washington, Abraham Lincoln, John Quincy Adams, and others.
****
**Have Fun,**
Dennis Speed

**Join Del. Sam Rasoul at the Grandin Theatre for a special panel discussion and screening of the Oscar-winning documentary, "No Other Land." ** "No Other Land" is a film made by a Palestinian-Israeli collective that shows the destruction of the occupied West Bank's Masafer Yatta by Israeli soldiers and the alliance that develops between the Palestinian activist Basel and Israeli journalist Yuval. Following the showing, there will be an important discussion, **"Repeating History: How Can We Resist?"** paneled by Mayor Joe Cobb, Virginia Tech Professor of Black Studies Dr. Brandy Faulkner, and Roanoke Historian Jordan Bell. In this discussion, we will be looking at our history, the concerning parallels today, and learning ways in which we can take action to prevent history from repeating itself. Please RSVP and attend the 2:20 pm showing to participate.

Extremists are still trying to overturn the results of the election last fall for the state supreme court. And if they succeed, they could try the same playbook to gain unearned power across the country.
Jefferson Griffin lost the race fair and square to incumbent Justice Allison Riggs. A win is a win, and Justice Riggs’ victory has been confirmed by two separate recounts! But Griffin is challenging more than 60,000 ballots with the help of his extreme partisan supporters.
Why? Well, before last November’s election, he said **he wants to ensure there’s a conservative majority on the court for the upcoming redistricting cycle, which could mean another decade of manipulated maps. We can’t let that happen.**
At All On The Line, we know that far-right extremists will go to any length to undermine fair representation and silence the will of the people.
**That’s why we’re fighting for fair maps and a truly representative democracy for voters in North Carolina and across the country, and it’s never been more urgent.**

This is what opponents of voting rights do: They scrape off discrete groups, challenging their eligibility or worthiness to be registered and cast a ballot, slicing their way down to a piece of the pie they can win and protect their power.
We won't stand for it and never will.
Please, watch the video below and then pitch in $25 or more today to defend everyone's right to vote and make every vote count nationwide >> [https://secure.everyaction.com/Z31SNww9Q0CZWIdx46cuSQ2]
Voter Action Project
Folks: You should watch this important update on bills attacking student voting around the country --
Democracy Docket YouTube Video: New GOP Bills Target Student Voters [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f2CS3Z72Uh4]
Long story short -- we often talk about how opponents of voting rights try out a concept in one state and, if successful, export it to other states. This has been happening for years with things like the reduction of polling places to create long lines, the criminalization of so-called "line warming" (giving out water of food to people in long voting lines), and more.
Now, lawmakers in Montana and Indiana are pushing bills to make it harder for students to participate in elections by redefining residency requirements for voter registration and removing student ID cards as an accepted form of voter ID. This comes after similar bills were successfully passed in states like Texas.
Disenfranchising and suppressing votes anywhere hurts us everywhere, since it changes the makeup of Congress. We want you to know that we oppose these harmful residency requirements and changing to voter ID laws. And as a 100% grassroots-funded organization, we need your help to fight back in the states -- including Texas, Montana, and Indiana -- that are considering these bills or have passed these laws.

clean_body: This is what opponents of voting rights do: They scrape off discrete groups, challenging their eligibility or worthiness to be registered and cast a ballot, slicing their way down to a piece of the pie they can win and protect their power. We won't stand for it and never will. Please, watch the video below and then pitch in $25 or more today to defend everyone's right to vote and make every vote count nationwide >> [] Voter Action Project Folks: You should watch this important update on bills attacking student voting around the country -- Democracy Docket YouTube Video: New GOP Bills Target Student Voters [] Long story short -- we often talk about how opponents of voting rights try out a concept in one state and, if successful, export it to other states. This has been happening for years with things like the reduction of polling places to create long lines, the criminalization of so-called "line warming" (giving out water of food to people in long voting lines), and more. Now, lawmakers in Montana and Indiana are pushing bills to make it harder for students to participate in elections by redefining residency requirements for voter registration and removing student ID cards as an accepted form of voter ID. This comes after similar bills were successfully passed in states like Texas. Disenfranchising and suppressing votes anywhere hurts us everywhere, since it changes the makeup of Congress. We want you to know that we oppose these harmful residency requirements and changing to voter ID laws. And as a 100% grassroots-funded organization, we need your help to fight back in the states -- including Texas, Montana, and Indiana -- that are considering these bills or have passed these laws. name: Katie Porter
subject: Here’s how Trump Republicans quietly chip away at vital programs
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Governor 2026
body:
We must fight back.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21486?t=1&akid=39539%2E3422442%2EGk3y-3)
Derek, this moment demands leaders who can effectively stand up to Trump. **That’s a big part of why I’m running for governor.**
_Here’s a longer story about a moment from the first Trump Administration that didn’t get much attention at the time, but it shows what’s at stake with this second Trump Administration.**[I hope you’ll read it, and consider chipping in $5 to our campaign against Donald Trump.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_kp_20250313_4_ak?refcode=em20250313-39539&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39539_3422442_Gk3y-3&akid=39539%2E3422442%2EGk3y-3)**_
* * *
It was a sleepy hearing in the Oversight Subcommittee on Economic and Consumer Policy. The title of the hearing was boring: “The Trump Administration’s Proposed Changes to Broad-Based Categorical Eligibility for the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program.”
Despite the long name, the topic was hunger. The Trump Administration had drafted a new rule to make it harder for families to get food assistance. **They wanted Americans who were already struggling to make ends meet to spend hours and hours filling out tedious and pointless forms.**
I’d seen this show before. **The reality of this paperwork burden is that those most in need don’t get help, because they don’t have the time and the process is too confusing.** But, the scammers, who are determined to game the system, continue to cheat anyway. So, the rate of fraud actually stays the same or even goes up, but with certainty—the rate of hunger gets worse.
The witness chosen by Republicans was someone who had worked in Maine to implement these kinds of cumbersome forms for families in need. The form he created for food assistance was six pages asking for hyper-specific information—more detailed than even I had to provide for my financial disclosure as a Congressmember.
So, I asked the witness: How much do you pay for utilities? How often do you pay for sewer and how much? What day are you paid? What is your hourly rate of pay?
At one point he tried to deflect: “I don’t know, but I could pull it up in 11 seconds.”
But, I didn’t let him off the hook: “Tick tock. I’ll wait,” I said, and I did.
He did not, in fact, find his info. So, he tried mansplaining: “I don’t see what this has to do with—”
I cut him off. “Excuse me. I ask the questions, and you may either answer or refuse to answer, which is your prerogative.”
Finally, I held up the six-page form he had designed, and I explained that those were just a fraction of the hoops families had to jump through so that they didn’t go hungry. **If he couldn’t answer those questions easily, why had he demanded that families, who have fewer resources than him, need to do it?**
By the way, that witness, **Sam Adolphsen, is now Donald Trump’s Deputy Assistant for Domestic Policy** , where he can wreak that same havoc on nearly every form of support we provide people who are struggling to make ends meet.
This year, Donald Trump and his cronies are bringing back the exact same playbook to tear down all the important government programs that Californians rely on. **We need fierce leaders standing up to them, and that’s why I made the decision to get into this race.**
I’m so grateful for the support I’ve so received so far, and I would love to have you on our team. Chipping in whatever you can makes a big difference.
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_kp_20250313_4_ak?refcode=em20250313-39539&refcode2=39539_3422442_Gk3y-3&akid=39539%2E3422442%2EGk3y-3)
Many thanks for reading,
Katie

Katie is running to be California’s next governor because California and our country need a leader who will stand up to Trump to lower costs, protect our rights, and combat climate change. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4g-em-footer?refcode=em20250313-39539&amounts=&t=3&refcode2=39539_3422442_Gk3y-3&akid=39539%2E3422442%2EGk3y-3)**

name: Mark Kelly
subject: I’m not going to vote to give unchecked power to Donald Trump and Elon Musk.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
I cannot give my permission when they’re firing thousands of veterans, and imposing inflation-causing tariffs on Arizonans and Americans.
#

Team, it’s Mark.
I’m voting against this partisan funding bill that the House passed on Tuesday.
As the Trump Administration and Elon Musk blow up critical agencies that millions of Americans depend on, I can’t just give them a pass.
Whether it’s NOAA and the National Weather Service, and cuts that undermine our ability to forecast and anticipate things like the forest fires that impact my state.

body:

**I wanted you to be the first to know that I just launched my campaign to unseat Derrick Van Orden and flip Wisconsin’s 3rd Congressional District.**
Last year, my race was one of the closest in the entire country as we united working folks from all stripes. When the nation shifted rightward, we still outperformed every other Democrat in this district in years.
Now, I’m running to finish the job in 2026.

Here’s more about why I’m in this race:
We outperformed every Democratic race in our district in 2024, reaching more than five points better than the top of the ticket, and even outperforming the winning Senate race.
We did it with a coalition that united working Wisconsinites, ranging from labor unions, to farmers, to students, and even voters who went with Trump.
And since that time, our call to put real, working class Wisconsinites first has only become more critical.
These past couple of months have the American people reeling from crushing attacks from this administration – policies that have put billionaires first and hit working families the hardest.
I’m feeling it personally. I’m still waitressing at the _Good Wives_ in Eau Claire, and I hear the same ongoing concerns from folks in our community. Basic costs of living like groceries and utility costs are still on the rise, health care is less accessible and affordable, family farms are folding, and home ownership feels further and further out of reach.
We can’t sit on the sidelines as the elites take up every last resource and leave all of us behind. We need action to have public service that works for us.
**I know what working families need, because I’m part of one. And I wouldn’t be in this race if I wasn’t confident we could finish the job. But I can’t do this alone:**

body:

| **Welcome to Keeping Up with Kathryn Harvey. A weekly digest covering South Carolina politics and opportunities for engagement and action in the Upstate.**
---
|
# Where is William Timmons?
---
| Seriously—where _is_ he? Our congressman sits on the DOGE subcommittee, rubber-stamping every ruthless cut unelected bureaucrat Elon Musk has shoved through—gutting the VA, slashing the Department of Education, and throwing working families under the bus. And yet, he refuses to face the people he’s hurting. No Town Halls. No accountability. Just silence.
The damage from Medicaid cuts and tariffs will be devastating for our district. And Timmons? Nowhere to be found.
Enough. Join me **Saturday, March 15, at 2PM** at the Hughes Library in Greenville for a Town Hall hosted by Indivisible Upstate. **Call his office—(202) 225-6030—and demand he show up.** The people of this district deserve answers.
---
| | | | | | | | | | [](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=a85b78b635&e=edbde6c9b1)

---
|
---
|
# Women and girls are worth fighting for.
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | I’ve spent my career standing up for women and girls. Not because it was easy— but because it was necessary.When I first stepped into this work, I didn’t know just how much it would shape me.
How much it would challenge me.
How much it would _matter_.Years ago, I had the extraordinary privilege of working on [girls empowerment ](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=f716a39c64&e=edbde6c9b1)programs through Sesame Workshop —the global nonprofit behind Sesame Street. There, I poured my energy into supporting initiatives that gave young girls a voice—not just to sing or smile, but to be strong, to be curious, to lead, to dream big. Because I believed then—and still do—that when girls see themselves reflected, they start to believe in their power.Now I’m back in my home town of Spartanburg, South Carolina—a place I love deeply.
But let’s be honest: there’s work to do here. There are things happening in this state that deeply affect women—our choices, our bodies, our futures.And while I may not be working for women and girls around the globe anymore, I’m still fighting here at home with amazing organizations like the [Women’s Rights & Empowerment Network](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=c4d3718b53&e=edbde6c9b1). Because there is still so much _worth fighting for_.This Women’s History Month, I’m reminded of the women who came before us—who marched, who taught, who healed, who built, who sacrificed.
And I’m reminded that history isn’t just something we read about.
It’s something we create—every single day.So, if you’re wondering whether your voice matters, whether your advocacy is too small, whether your presence can make a difference—let me tell you: it does.And we need you to stay in this fight.

subject: Republicans are a bunch of overgrown schoolyard bullies
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
Our constituents shouldn’t have to suffer because Republicans want to act like children.
Hi Peter, it’s Congresswoman Sarah McBride. Pramila said I could reach out because you have what it takes to stand up in critical moments — and this is one of them.
**Yet another GOP politician decided to get his own 15 Minutes of Twitter Fame at my expense.**
At a subcommittee hearing, the Republican chairman referred to me as “Mr. McBride.” And when Rep. Bill Keating defended me, the chair _adjourned the hearing_ to avoid acknowledging his own immaturity.
**Republicans are a bunch of overgrown schoolyard bullies.**
Our constituents shouldn’t have to suffer because Republicans want to act like children. **This pettiness needs to end.** I was there ready to ask questions on nuclear non-proliferation and US support for our democratic allies in Europe.
**I ran for Congress to roll up my sleeves and do the job.** No matter what they throw at me, I’m 100% focused on delivering for Delawareans. And if that means listening to their childish insults, _so be it._
[**Peter, I’m proud to have Pramila’s support at this moment, but we need you with us. Can you split an urgent $3 contribution to help us cut through the noise and keep up the fight for all of us?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20250313?refcode=em20250313-4846&amount=3&refcode2=4846_420207_tvddbW&akid=4846%2E420207%2EtvddbW)

name: Adam Schiff
subject: I’m voting against the CR. Here’s why:
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=8363%2E5257348%2EItYHlD ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Derek,

Soon the United States Senate will hold a vote on a six-month Continuing
Resolution (CR) to fund our government.

I am a hard no. I hope this CR is defeated, but I fear it may not be. Let
me tell you more about the stakes of this vote and why I am so adamantly
opposed.

This is a power giveaway to an executive that is already drunk with power.

It would embolden the president to continue illegally tearing down
government services to people in need. Closing Social Security offices.
Slashing Medicaid. Empowering mass deportations and more.

But worst of all is that by voting for this continuing resolution we would
be giving him that power. It’s one thing for those who aspire to
dictatorship to take power. It is another to knowingly give it away.

I will not do that.

Since taking office, Donald Trump, Elon Musk, and their enablers have
arrogated to themselves powers that do not belong to them under the
Constitution. They have done so to slash benefits to hardworking Americans
to fund a tax cut for billionaires.

If we pass this CR, we will own what the president does for the next six
months. And Derek,
if you’re like me, you do not want any
ownership over his autocratic, harmful agenda.

Derek, I’ve
heard from concerned citizens about what happens if the government shuts
down. That is certainly not the desired outcome.

But if the government shuts down, it is on Republicans. They control the
House, the Senate, the White House, and the Supreme Court. If we knowingly
hand more power to Donald Trump, that is on us.

Personally, this is not a hard decision. I am desperately worried about
the direction of this country — as are so many others — and I refuse to
give the executive branch a blank check to continue tearing down our
democracy.

I will vote no on this CR, and I will continue speaking out against it.

Thank you,

Adam

### **I applied for a film grant from Vimeo, Red, and Nikon**
---
**Funding Proposal for Vimeo Short Film Grant | Presented by Nikon | RED****The funds awarded by the Vimeo Short Film Grant would be essential in elevating** _**Frozen Odds: The Game of Alaska's Election**_**to a professional standard that captures the complexity and emotional depth of Alaska's 2022 election. While I have invested in key equipment such as the RED Scarlet-W, RED Komodo 6K, and high-quality audio gear, additional resources are crucial to enhance production value and effectively convey the film's message.****Grant funds would be allocated as follows:**
1. **Travel & Location Shoots: Capturing Alaska’s vast and remote landscapes is critical to visually telling this story. Funds would support travel to key locations such as Anchorage, Fairbanks, and smaller rural communities where the impact of the election was deeply felt.**
2. **Cinematography & Visual Effects: To illustrate complex voting mechanics like Ranked Choice Voting, funds would enable the creation of clear, animated visual explanations that simplify the process for viewers. This is vital for ensuring the film is accessible to all audiences.**
3. **Post-Production & Editing: Funds will allow me to secure a professional colorist and sound designer to refine the final product, ensuring consistency in visual tone and immersive audio quality.**
4. **Interviews & Expert Commentary: The grant will support travel and technical costs for conducting interviews with election officials, political experts, and grassroots campaigners whose insights are crucial to telling this story.**

**With this support, I can create a powerful, visually striking documentary that reveals the challenges of Alaska’s 2022 election and explores what this experience means for democracy across America.**
---
#### **Frozen Odds -**
**Alaska — vast, untamed, and unpredictable. Beneath its snow-covered peaks and icy rivers lies a political battlefield unlike any other. name: Hillsdale College via American Defense News
subject: Defeat DEI Survey
body:
It’s time for merit to make a comeback.

This sponsored message from American Defense News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zv97pltpfq879vi6t2bv6dkgdrlq4gcerjid769o_rp22sh2s8i6eob4cjgm6ob6c1h2bs)
---
| |
Dear Friend of Liberty,

It's time for merit to make a comeback.

[That's why I'm writing to ask you to participate in Hillsdale College's **DEFEAT DEI SURVEY**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zaphpr8kcmiqhuqdgmqk3llr91m8e54bmaq1iar0_rp22sh2s8i6eob4cjgm6ob6c1h2bs).

Like many Americans, I'm sure you're all too aware of the damage that has been done to our country by policies implemented in the name of "Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion" or "DEI."

Race grifters and hustlers make _millions_ perpetuating DEI lies, including...

* America is a nation built on slavery, not freedom.
* All racial disparities are indisputable evidence of systemic racism--and if you question this conclusion, you must be a racist.
* Students in K-12 schools can be divided into oppressors and oppressed based on their skin color.

DEI policies have infected almost every aspect of American life, from K-12 schools to college admissions and job applications. They have even spread into the hard sciences and the military.

These policies endanger lives and, ultimately, Western Civilization itself.

I'm sure, like a lot of Americans, you want to know what you can do to stop DEI. One of the most fundamental steps is ...

**Countering the far-Left ideologies that are being taught to students in K-12 schools, colleges, and universities.**

Hillsdale College, where I am president, is engaged in a nationwide fight on the battlefield of education to save young Americans from this anti-American agenda.

Since our founding in 1844, we have offered "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty."

To do this work well, we need a clear understanding of **what informed Americans like you think about DEI and how best to fight it.**

So please share your views by completing the **DEFEAT DEI SURVEY** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time.

Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept any government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations.

**We remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities have rejected their founding statements and embraced radical and dangerous ideologies.**

Please join Hillsdale College in our defense of Western Civilization by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **DEFEAT DEI SURVEY** , which you can access at this secure link:

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/defeat-dei-survey**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zoboepnap7bn14t82nu8g2p954qndgm7skfa6q4o_rp22sh2s8i6eob4cjgm6ob6c1h2bs)

With your help, we will continue our work to defeat the tyranny of low standards and to restore excellence in America.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S. Please fill out your **DEFEAT DEI SURVEY** today. Your answers will help us to defend excellence and merit against the tyranny of DEI. Today, DEI affects almost every aspect of American life. This endangers lives and, ultimately, Western Civilization itself.

You can take your survey at the secure link below. It will only take a few moments of your time.

[https://info.hillsdale.edu/defeat-dei-survey](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z4169kh1hhe78sp0nsgf40vm5kvr23u1lj4s54do_rp22sh2s8i6eob4cjgm6ob6c1h2bs)

Thank you!

**Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's hear.com's **new IX hearing aid.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It’s no wonder **hear.com's IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year** offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.
[Check if you qualify](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zoesjan4qh9uoptq476p59r1j33h6ikbepre0vu8_rp22sh2s8i6eob4cjgm6ob3c1h2bs)

What makes hear.com’s IX hearing aid so special?

It’s one of **the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This is special because it’s the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small.

The result? **An unprecedented amount of power and clarity.**

This means that hear.com’s IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids—from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming—with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

“It's not just about volume,” explains hear.com founder Paul Crusius. “It's about speech clarity. And that's precisely what IX is designed to optimize.”

In other words: **with double the power comes double the clarity—and all that in a virtually invisible design!**

It’s time for merit to make a comeback.

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zpo4o5diohbm4eu3oggjsui93abv8cf564vdf6c0_rp22sh2s8i6eob4cjgmepj4cdh2bs)

| |
Dear Friend of Liberty,

It's time for merit to make a comeback.

[That's why I'm writing to ask you to participate in Hillsdale College's **DEFEAT DEI SURVEY**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0ual0c8bl1urm3o93aq06ln8a82posnqtdqhnd8_rp22sh2s8i6eob4cjgmepj4cdh2bs).

Like many Americans, I'm sure you're all too aware of the damage that has been done to our country by policies implemented in the name of "Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion" or "DEI."

Race grifters and hustlers make _millions_ perpetuating DEI lies, including...

* America is a nation built on slavery, not freedom.
* All racial disparities are indisputable evidence of systemic racism--and if you question this conclusion, you must be a racist.
* Students in K-12 schools can be divided into oppressors and oppressed based on their skin color.

DEI policies have infected almost every aspect of American life, from K-12 schools to college admissions and job applications. They have even spread into the hard sciences and the military.

These policies endanger lives and, ultimately, Western Civilization itself.

I'm sure, like a lot of Americans, you want to know what you can do to stop DEI. One of the most fundamental steps is ...

**Countering the far-Left ideologies that are being taught to students in K-12 schools, colleges, and universities.**

Hillsdale College, where I am president, is engaged in a nationwide fight on the battlefield of education to save young Americans from this anti-American agenda.

Since our founding in 1844, we have offered "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty."

To do this work well, we need a clear understanding of **what informed Americans like you think about DEI and how best to fight it.**

So please share your views by completing the **DEFEAT DEI SURVEY** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time.

Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept any government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations.

**We remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities have rejected their founding statements and embraced radical and dangerous ideologies.**

Please join Hillsdale College in our defense of Western Civilization by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **DEFEAT DEI SURVEY** , which you can access at this secure link:

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/defeat-dei-survey**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ze3t5kmudd03g86vtbue4c889ac652j1k76f6qc8_rp22sh2s8i6eob4cjgmepj4cdh2bs)

With your help, we will continue our work to defeat the tyranny of low standards and to restore excellence in America.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S. Please fill out your **DEFEAT DEI SURVEY** today. Your answers will help us to defend excellence and merit against the tyranny of DEI. Today, DEI affects almost every aspect of American life. This endangers lives and, ultimately, Western Civilization itself.

You can take your survey at the secure link below. It will only take a few moments of your time.

[https://info.hillsdale.edu/defeat-dei-survey](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6qj18d145afac9arjc1fdpriv6ef5jsq5208ru8_rp22sh2s8i6eob4cjgmepj4cdh2bs)

The result? **An unprecedented amount of power and clarity.**

[](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zava4fld96vu4t6r9fbk0b79a1nqqsi3t31nqdeg_rp22sh2s8i6eob4cjim0o32cjh2bs)
**Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's [hear.com's](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z5qoniit8l9trt0fdksftcuvf8uti3f47v9l2d4g_rp22sh2s8i6eob4cjim0o32cjh2bs) **new IX hearing aid.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

name: Hillsdale College via First Look News
subject: Defeat DEI Survey
body:
It’s time for merit to make a comeback.

This sponsored message from First Look is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zgu2auh3grodrga1um60uq51q2g12gdmig2u3ilg_rp22sh2s8i6eob4cjim0p76chh2bs)
---
| |
Dear Friend of Liberty,

It's time for merit to make a comeback.

[That's why I'm writing to ask you to participate in Hillsdale College's **DEFEAT DEI SURVEY**](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zsff6qt8h0l6730ujiibir30kcjc94d6a7dqqdr8_rp22sh2s8i6eob4cjim0p76chh2bs).

Like many Americans, I'm sure you're all too aware of the damage that has been done to our country by policies implemented in the name of "Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion" or "DEI."

Race grifters and hustlers make _millions_ perpetuating DEI lies, including...

* America is a nation built on slavery, not freedom.
* All racial disparities are indisputable evidence of systemic racism--and if you question this conclusion, you must be a racist.
* Students in K-12 schools can be divided into oppressors and oppressed based on their skin color.

DEI policies have infected almost every aspect of American life, from K-12 schools to college admissions and job applications. They have even spread into the hard sciences and the military.

These policies endanger lives and, ultimately, Western Civilization itself.

I'm sure, like a lot of Americans, you want to know what you can do to stop DEI. One of the most fundamental steps is ...

**Countering the far-Left ideologies that are being taught to students in K-12 schools, colleges, and universities.**

Hillsdale College, where I am president, is engaged in a nationwide fight on the battlefield of education to save young Americans from this anti-American agenda.

Since our founding in 1844, we have offered "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty."

To do this work well, we need a clear understanding of **what informed Americans like you think about DEI and how best to fight it.**

So please share your views by completing the **DEFEAT DEI SURVEY** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time.

Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept any government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations.

**We remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities have rejected their founding statements and embraced radical and dangerous ideologies.**

Please join Hillsdale College in our defense of Western Civilization by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **DEFEAT DEI SURVEY** , which you can access at this secure link:

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/defeat-dei-survey**](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zp92j5ja0ddbmnvfbknm52enpoej8ut4g4h9hp40_rp22sh2s8i6eob4cjim0p76chh2bs)

With your help, we will continue our work to defeat the tyranny of low standards and to restore excellence in America.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S. Please fill out your **DEFEAT DEI SURVEY** today. Your answers will help us to defend excellence and merit against the tyranny of DEI. Today, DEI affects almost every aspect of American life. This endangers lives and, ultimately, Western Civilization itself.

You can take your survey at the secure link below. It will only take a few moments of your time.

[https://info.hillsdale.edu/defeat-dei-survey](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zl526tn62dvus4uspkp0lkk683tkb1moa8b5mp9g_rp22sh2s8i6eob4cjim0p76chh2bs)

Thank you!

## Putin Backs Ceasefire, Seeks Call with Trump
Russian President Vladimir [Putin said Thursday he supports a U.S.-proposed 30-day ceasefire](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00L2upCAcBfCnwQ7DN2NBsY3dbLulQfkzw4pgAMd4n_7G29_uJL_k5OT8e05PG2JIr792A9N8nhhhEhOOqZicDfGaROeMB2DAOzBUCzoIJSnp3kYqu3AJSsxOc-Kk5txrp6T3g-bKDl0wdxvhVFBCqNA9Eco_HlIyPg-M0BkJAi60XPr_OaT2Bh-v_IHSL3nronm3tlfE_yA2Ijae59mneUlw1tsRG-94Qy7RITaWo9Zg8X60kPCxFhsS4C-IkOp6XXg9Sl1xK8e24zO0NXuPd7AL4GRbxnCUvAMuS7J0UFTLrhi3nyHGUJVGgrw2G-LPsvbbUx_DvgMAAP__eONs1A) in Ukraine but stressed more talks are needed, possibly including a call with President Trump. The comment was Moscow’s first public response to a U.S.-backed 30-day ceasefire plan outlined this week.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr [Zelensky warned that Putin](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDtuwzAQBU8jdTT4WZFWwSKNO6dNKSzFlbUx9QFJ2XBOHzh9yocHDAbzdR2uyInX2ycu5Ou0DVrqTkgjFAwROb0GaKOfiDSZlrxyoHqwnZLt7NFGcL0B1xkDKKknNY3OarQuRAx9y_5Nk0aBklKBO0mw0_ncddqEXksVGpAUuW759L3xWmea0mt7UD6N29ImP9e6l8Z8NPrS6AvuKz3L-3qPXHlM1OhLPkphFMc9I68knpjF_cjlLsoRf-aAYuHEFfNLbON47Fh5W4VyI4UwarCgMXQ2urNSmgI6Cq6TfZt93J-cEhfrGpC3BTn9WdX_Kj28_g0AAP__LKBpLw) would reject the ceasefire and “is afraid to tell President Trump directly that he wants to continue this war, that he wants to kill Ukrainians.”
## Trump Threatens 200% Tariff on EU Alcohol
President Trump on Thursday threatened to impose [a 200% tariff on wine, champagne, and other European alcohol](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGu4yAQAL8Gd0TLGuy4oLjGXa690iJ4ifeEwcKbRPn7U65_9Ugz0vy5LbfAmcvjd9jJS6oLAjoNvTZ2WQPnz2K71ScipL4jb0ZrJjs4A93mI4SIEByZFBK5IUY73a2Lk6OII04d-68NemMNgLHjBeyQrlfnsL9PCOauLNDKUtvlb-UiG6X8qS9ql1j3LvtN5DhV_0vhrHCWjTbO-csUzlvdqdD7VDiHdefCp7QgXIvC2ZkJbd9rac_90LI1CkLl1AigD2qRimgJjVPS9NRvLqRw7ppfjzfnzOcwKguPPfD_WCc_jXl5_BcAAP__E19lNA) unless the European Union drops its new 50% tariff on American whiskey. body:
Here is our next mission >>>

| | | | |
---
Friend – I’ve spent some of the best years of my life fighting to save America from the radical left. Sometimes, that meant sacrificing the things I cherish most.
I’ve missed birthdays, special occasions, and time with my family because I know the future of our country is on the line.
I’ve come home exhausted after securing victories for President Trump and the GOP in battleground states. I’ve _knocked doors_ , _registered voters_ , and _fought legal battles_ to ensure that **every legal vote counts**.
This isn’t just politics for me - it’s personal.
My father, a veteran, taught me what it means to love our country. My mother, the strongest woman I know, poured everything into raising our family. Even when I go months without seeing them, they understand why this fight matters and why I’ll never stop.

_**How We Flipped Pennsylvania**_

When the establishment wrote off Pennsylvania, we _dug in_. We didn’t just talk - we acted. We trained thousands of grassroots volunteers, sent teams door-to-door in deep-blue counties, and**we registered over 70,000 new Republican voters**. We took the fight straight to the Left’s ballot-harvesting operations, outworked them, and **_we delivered Pennsylvania for President Trump_**.

**_Now, We’re Doing the Same in New Jersey_**

The Democrats think New Jersey is safe. They think their machine will keep them in power. But we’re proving them wrong.

* We’ve already registered tens of thousands of**new Republican voters**.
* We’re building a **ballot-harvesting army** to compete where it matters most.
* We’re targeting **key swing districts** that could tip the balance of power in 2024.

**_Here’s Where You Come In_**

We’re running a full-scale ground operation in New Jersey **_[but we need the resources to finish the job](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a8bz/?__vbtrk=Mjc5NTM1OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc5NTM1OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_.**
Every dollar you give will go straight into **_[registering more voters, training more volunteers, and ensuring that every Republican ballot gets counted](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a8bz/?__vbtrk=Mjc5NTM1OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc5NTM1OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_.**
**We flipped Pennsylvania.****Now, let’s flip New Jersey.**

**__[Can I count on you to help finish the job](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a8bz/?__vbtrk=Mjc5NTM1OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc5NTM1OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)__**** _?_**

[CHIP IN NOW](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a8bz/?__vbtrk=Mjc5NTM1OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc5NTM1OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
_Forever Fighting,_

**Scott Presler** Founder, Early Vote Action

This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/s/c/ngiutoSqfR2VgWzujKEjYXA2HDxeW3wRKjiDYw-AOYKgLNT8F0BOOZ-sMDhYPlGoeuU90KeoxNL3V4A26MtlLkTDHbw2UE9qoj9sdymJapF7nDpIniQTy45D3tgpR-p-dcmkKTr_nX3QB-x3GqROptSQUVj682FG7SHoNtqP_YdB6zn62N9KBeoFTNwn2kG8jeH1Uu2_3gyBRK013mrBttNKzKtOMAPYWRjn1pnNDAypiEmL6252mhjGjGZjvvxi7NHswdzAhq5c8rshTpr0NrVxp7jwy1xgzNzCJGm5kPJ7U9BI1bb1dpzV1wFA3UlHxjaQAzf2IwennSjA_r00an4ZAw3TQWLIyYpIdFEcdwLlDdY6ZImv6iZKer-FoId6ZNt3O1tCgd2ukPFB7oGjXmCc72d0ZRP2wcgPeaIxSmKtq5ILDOiCR406lxrN5g/_TeV9ns2qw5PaQPRmaGNHcEwwaWqU2y3/7)

Dear Friend of Liberty,

It's time for merit to make a comeback.

[That's why I'm writing to ask you to participate in Hillsdale College's **DEFEAT DEI SURVEY**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/s/c/nfiDHJ1sak67WyVwda-IJiucDhFCVkGVB1NNIiiyMJz3PJ8XQraWNvrmrXRmrSx4z7YP19ALN7RcYbrbqQMzV45in7frsx5iiOt4FqFgCg6F2v5xyaV26-gGM_cbvlCi_hmsoBiOZjM6IhtbMP5Salk15m-ZhVQeODvwhBIhSPElVFNG1cWlgiZd0GDczYvI6iTwFZfoaNJrkcoqdMasTWeet_YTO90PJMJuMgkDUD-yyJOQkMJEE5i3A0T0buZKCVAOe8cYzML_MuS2xPsopDGzr4_b9QekOfONaYM1euLe9WHq5RoNlZa7PcVd_IaknyJ70f8zRc9aj15pNaFe3yR7D7OUmwJuFznssPLtsyhRZ9lLkGcBOPRmEZsgmPfHfmDoiKMvLXjGVj7bkGDYByd5sdsN5x3WxSXEJGcjta8joUEBwMzekZQGvhQfzg/WVYGPisCn-G-4HsFbLzzAOYzRarJ_Z0r/7).

Like many Americans, I'm sure you're all too aware of the damage that has been done to our country by policies implemented in the name of "Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion" or "DEI."

Race grifters and hustlers make _millions_ perpetuating DEI lies, including...

* America is a nation built on slavery, not freedom.
* All racial disparities are indisputable evidence of systemic racism--and if you question this conclusion, you must be a racist.
* Students in K-12 schools can be divided into oppressors and oppressed based on their skin color.

DEI policies have infected almost every aspect of American life, from K-12 schools to college admissions and job applications. They have even spread into the hard sciences and the military.

These policies endanger lives and, ultimately, Western Civilization itself.

I'm sure, like a lot of Americans, you want to know what you can do to stop DEI. One of the most fundamental steps is ...

**Countering the far-Left ideologies that are being taught to students in K-12 schools, colleges, and universities.**

Hillsdale College, where I am president, is engaged in a nationwide fight on the battlefield of education to save young Americans from this anti-American agenda.

Since our founding in 1844, we have offered "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty."

To do this work well, we need a clear understanding of **what informed Americans like you think about DEI and how best to fight it.**

So please share your views by completing the **DEFEAT DEI SURVEY** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time.

Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept any government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations.

**We remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities have rejected their founding statements and embraced radical and dangerous ideologies.**

Please join Hillsdale College in our defense of Western Civilization by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **DEFEAT DEI SURVEY** , which you can access at this secure link:

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/defeat-dei-survey**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/s/c/_cUMPESDxMeWBqk3-SjuTYEC41jbeJCZHeP2nBr5TCGjZiPPxscg--YPavdn4uS00_-ZoDW9LXkgNiLiBJUt7fDBU7PbEkPTfHVbHxs2O0a_miXgumbyazFP8682md0X7RbHitD94Uzzogo3ak52AOI90hcrTWlKfy_FeQqfk3O5X6vamIMVZ1G-FUDD2b94xPFacIYg2TwhWfw7l1yPeDj8CTR19o-eTCXGNNgxCNvD0mwbWcesAXCeWDFLTSwt-yElqD-jnzJaZri2QgWqTnNmgwTOA3R2LRsZ-VVqP02guvVOF7pJV-uba9OUjbELSqQCJqD4zwbMhYVVb6rr59geWp7y3QTT2dENXTOFP2wvQe42v64prjYrilvU2DA-_zEI6FVGlCUwbOMi_s05saH83KE4UU1OCvrry5n2GjXE9PUx4ZrEwcoTdoVqmQ/Sg3kj431_IQCn4avz7UYALfGTfxLL8AC/7)

With your help, we will continue our work to defeat the tyranny of low standards and to restore excellence in America.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Race grifters and hustlers make millions perpetuating DEI lies, including... America is a nation built on slavery, not freedom. All racial disparities are indisputable evidence of systemic racism--and if you question this conclusion, you must be a racist. Students in K-12 schools can be divided into oppressors and oppressed based on their skin color. DEI policies have infected almost every aspect of American life, from K-12 schools to college admissions and job applications. They have even spread into the hard sciences and the military. These policies endanger lives and, ultimately, Western Civilization itself. I'm sure, like a lot of Americans, you want to know what you can do to stop DEI. One of the most fundamental steps is ... Countering the far-Left ideologies that are being taught to students in K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. # **Who is the Modern Freedom Caucus?**
---
| [](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2ws0at-vm7bp5-kyd76rh5/)
---
| | | | Dear friend, In the past two weeks, the House Freedom Caucus made moves once thought unimaginable for a group of far-right rebels. The same faction that used to hold out against spending bills and debt ceiling increases has now **unanimously supported a $4 trillion debt limit increase** and a **government funding bill that largely continues President Biden’s agenda**. How did this shift happen? **Donald Trump.** Once a group focused on fiscal conservatism, the Freedom Caucus has become **Trump’s biggest ally** , fiercely loyal to his policies. They are now fully aligned with Trump’s agenda, even supporting spending measures they once vehemently opposed. This transformation is dangerous. Trump has **transformed the GOP** , from fiscal conservatives to culture warriors, with the Freedom Caucus now working as his most dedicated supporters. These extremists are determined to push Trump’s agenda, even if it means abandoning the very principles they once fought for. They’ve become a **tool of Trump’s power** , aligning with him at every turn, and undermining efforts to hold them accountable. But we can’t let them continue to dominate our politics. The Freedom Caucus and Trump are playing dangerous games with our government, undermining the progress we've made and threatening the future of our democracy. We must **defeat them** before they push us even further toward an authoritarian future. [**_Join the fight to stand up for democracy. We need your support to keep fighting these extremists and protect our future. Donate today to help take down the Freedom Caucus and their dangerous agenda. Together, we can defeat Trump’s grip on our government and take back control for the people._**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2ws0at-vm7bp6-kyd76rh6/) In Solidarity, The No Dem Left Behind Team

**Good morning!** On this day in 1940, King Ranch president Robert J. Kleberg met with other livestock professionals in Fort Worth to form the [American Quarter Horse Association](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z71uwyAUQOGngc0W9wLGDAxdvKVrR-uGnxgJx6lBcfz2VbpnPtInnZ_LfKFc8v32TWt07ZW2GQXqTsgO1Bwol3NWPLirCBZ4dGAUWC0AFV-cTejJ6OsoJA2DMtZ7YzAYjwCEPvHs3piQoEDoEXQvvU2JRi1hAOuTYkrEkNu2922JLb6opnJuz7j3flt5cUtrj8rkF8OJ4XQcR0-_C70jw2nJtW372dE9dIl8q3x34XHkUnIdDFPitlIu_1L7uPZ0-BcAAP__BmtQrA). Yesterday marked 50 years since Chili's [opened its first restaurant](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kTGP3CAUhH-N3b0VYFjjwkUad5c25eotPBaUt2YFnDn_-2hPSrrUM_ONRvPr4_aBidP--IlPWttXyDcllAExgdQ3j4nPmx79ehd-kSOtctZyMUIqPcbVLCFYM1vnF22Uk9baRU2KZKC7l24e0_qGiUlqKYyV5jK5JQS0ZpJXubigBy3Ip5bLpUVq9IU18JkPKheXnyOvsbVXHaYfg9oGtfXeLz0gvsVBbVhackyD2nbqdVAbZ4f89kUqBD55cDFxqlAblgYembHCnkuL8F0GjKWcwHiknQDhQH6H8u7o1aBFgsfnCT1mSPtBe6N_xLT_xTVirvBZoccTUoOey2_yg9qUncF4HWYrBNCdFtBWIqCYLFy9ITEt090SjmX1r56YU73OgxaPJyb-3t_-e8ixqj8BAAD__2-Ojuw) in an old converted post office on Greenville Avenue in Dallas. ## Explosion Rocks Texas Tech
An [explosion at Texas Tech University](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO6yAURL8Gd1hwgcQUFK-hy2u3tDC-2CgEIkPs-O9XSb_lSKMzo_NzG28uppiX_-6Bpr1DGYGBokxQLsfZxXSOspvNxGbNOzT8KrlWjIPsVuP8IKcAMGg1KQaIM2o5Cx-mKTAdsIvmA2OCS87UwFUvvA7BDUrwC9c-SCIZzrGVrW8rNny7GtJZdtx6Xx5dMmtrz0rEPwKWgD2Oo0-vaSr-XnKKGT8tAra2sp0EbMajErCfTQKWCQKWAwH7BdOGfqV1dRtW6hJurdKSKeYlZsQt5oXe8aS4O_9yLZZcKRZPnW9x_2YCdgAhpVCasSsB221mfh4xpVgvVyLZ8nAxfY-3P03uBn4DAAD__z7xdf4) on Wednesday sparked multiple fires and cut power to much of the campus, prompting administrators to order evacuations and cancel classes for the rest of the week. Students are on Spring Break next week. The explosion occurred in a transformer vault, and fires were seen coming from nearby manhole covers. A witness reported that a “smoke ring” [reached 200 feet into the air](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2OwyAQhJ_G7ohYfgIUFNeky7VXWhjvxisR2zJcft7-5PRXjkYz-vT9XIdr4sLL7TvdMbYXrYOSygqpBZhhSlzeg-mnOMopQI8RnIFgJSjTz5FUhtHqJD0FrZzCMznpTFCewGh0PcfjTGowIK0He9I5ECVvNZwhZDKdkThxW_dTm7HhK1Uq7_WB-ymv977EubWtdvqrU5dOXdK24LMe1RH2xrlgpy6fnWiYZ_G78AP3yu0t8LWVtfK6COIdq1CU0TvvPHhEO1ptATFkO0o5odbU73HanlwK17PrjLzdE5cPRvvXyyOqvwAAAP__ihlkXA), and an official with Lubbock Fire Rescue said multicolored flames were likely caused by copper and other metals burning. [No injuries were reported](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGuqzAQRL_GdEa7a5tA4eI1dHntLZHBS7Dk2Ch2QvL3V6S_zVSjM6Pzc52uLsSQbv_dnW19r3kiICNBSdSTdyF-Jt14O4MfsGGLF42DASTdbLYfvDagZ6Lusho3GGBHqtfgPc0dQRPsCQOFGsH0aFq1DOvqeqOww2FZtdDAPtT8aOvGld-urPGTX_xol3xvot1q3YtQ_wSNgsbjONrER1k2lxJHhLMlaDxHBI2gBI14xpckKy-bvIUXF_ncvassy3Mu1dWQk-T3HnMJOQkam4f1-xFiDKW7CA23uwvx-6D-qeRl6TcAAP__3ANiOw), and affected areas of campus are closed as officials investigate what caused the explosion. As of Thursday, about 40% of the campus was still without power. The school is providing temporary housing for students who cannot go home over Spring Break, and H-E-B is providing meals to students who typically eat in the dining halls.
## Former Megachurch Pastor Indicted
Robert Morris, the 63-year-old former televangelist and pastor of North Texas megachurch Gateway, has been [indicted by a grand jury in Oklahoma](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2OpDAQhJ_GZI3cxiwQOLiEbC-9EBn_gCVjj-ye9czbn5h80_pUpdL373v71iGGdPzVl1P08nkTXIzAB0C5WR3ie5OdVTu3C3ZO4SRxGTkK2Z2K47RrKacZ_c4FjsMi0QzaGqdxwXnvgrrH-IAS-Tjj2A9m8V7P44BfuBgvmeTOBsqlp9ORe-nq4zv_uNKbfHVRnUSPyoY_TKxMrK213uw1uVZvzsT6qTCx3hET66HJNf0Gcz6LOcHnZ7IhHfDQlXKBkndXCK5cSqgQkg2GnIWcYASTn4kqZA_RNQu53NwZlwi0oQot0AkazBmiZWLtirKPFmIM9Wtikh-XDvFzmn61-KPE_wAAAP__7nZ3vA) on charges of indecency with a child. It’s the latest development following his admission of "inappropriate sexual behavior" with a teenage girl for several years in the 1980s, which led to his resignation last year from the church he founded in 2000. Last June, Cindy Clemishire accused Morris of molesting her at her family’s home in Hominy, Oklahoma, beginning in 1982, when she was just 12 years old. According to a statement from Oklahoma Attorney General Gentner Drummond, the statute of limitations doesn’t apply because Morris [wasn’t a resident of Oklahoma](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2uozAUhJ8GOiP_wqVwwRZ0SZsSHewDWGvsyPYGePsV6W81I430afS9HtMDnHdhfcKOupxLnDjlilBBmJwsOH9NsrZ6prZnNWrWSdYryrisN23mtsW57xaKs-ASABRnQqh5bjuusKudvmFUMMmo-mGqEaZfFvhRgrWsN4usJEXrSkxN2bDgCXnxV_xgakzca6-3Ut65EkPFx4qPx3E0ew73VvERA_mXKz4GPO749hRnTIXsMSWXiQvWmYKWxEDM5rwlGU9iNkgrZhL_etjiDgRKiSngRVYMmMCTDNcNg0SGgQ3PP-erTtq-D-e9y21XSbru4Pz3Y_lV2kfz_wEAAP__3WFwxg) at the time. "_After almost 43 years, the law has finally caught up with Robert Morris for the horrific crimes he committed against me as a child_ ," [said Clemishire](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L2O2zAQBOCnobo1-P9TsEij7tKmNFbk0iJAWQeKPtlvHyh9ysEAHzDz5-v-hbXV5-M3bhTHu-x3yaUBrkDoe8baPnc95bjwHMREUTgtguFC6mmNdkk2L8EFo1wwWmWnudPSBrJFBc-nGi-MK6EFN16Ym0qhFPRGCStCKpppTrmOvd_GSoPeeJT22X-o39K-TS2uY3wfTP1icmZyPs_zdhbEq2Ryxj5qasTk_KTzYHJOvW5XfOCgEz-Q1ldPK5T99czUoe8L9QHb3ns9oD5zTYMyYBnUIa21ZTjo_cIGuLwOgtSwbpcrvQNhjPdeOchKBNDCWvDKJjA8K45Ok-I09Zi_z9paPaxjmj82rO3fkvHfa3-i_BsAAP__vYl5Qw). "_Now, it is time for the legal system to hold him accountable_."
## Texas Counties among Fastest-Growing
Four counties in Texas were among the fastest-growing in the country over the past year, according to [estimates released yesterday](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LGOszAQBOCnMZ2RbQyBwsXf0OVvr0SLWcCSjZF3E5K3P-WuvvYrZkbzdZ_uEGI4tv-Q0PFrzZNRppWqkdpOC4T4nmy1uFktg67Q6ZvVQ6u0sdXurDe26ft-ni203dx3y7ysuvOA3Yr-BlVwnzDVaKtV2-u2bvywrtC3je704FcrrMIlcC4178j4AlrjOz-x1D6nKrqd-STR_BNmFGa8rqv2eNCD6i0_hRkPvKjknIQZz4JEsmBEICRhxk_zx_P5iMAhHxKJQwJGkj4_Dg5IMiGXLFPwJdc7pyhM80tQEEieWDweLLeSL96r4pbzCjEG6m7Cqi1BiD9D-c_nns58BwAA__9NaHS4) by the U.S. Census Bureau. Between July 1, 2023, and July 1, 2024, Kaufman County’s population increased by 11,114 and grew at a rate of 6%, second in the nation behind Dawson County in Georgia, which gained just over 2,000 residents but grew at a rate of 6.4%. Liberty, Montgomery, and Caldwell counties were the nation’s sixth (5.4%), seventh (4.8%), and ninth (4.6%) fastest-growing counties. Harris County’s 105,852 new residents are the most of any county in the country and make it the [first in Texas to surpass 5 million residents](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j7-SgyAQh58GOp3dZTGhoLjGLtde6RCBhDkUJ5IY3_7G9Ff__nzz_VyGi0s5zbdvNwVb37EMBKQbUA3y4F3K-8DS2yt4gzJYPDEaDUgs73Y0GvgUO4rslb_C1YA3gbhDxYxeyWSPM1DICPqMulWjidGdtcIOzRhZMASfanm09R5qeLs15r28wqMdyySzvde6rEJ9CeoF9du2tb9vNx-hoH4O2yqo_8wE9QTEzViec92bpSzP7GoqcxPWmiZXw1GRD-uXLeWc1u4kGG6TS_mDqv-6vyz9BQAA___kz1ty). Overall, Texas gained 562,941 new residents last year—more than any other state—approximately 309,506 of whom [came from other countries](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL-SgyAQxp8GOxxYwGhBcQ1drr3SIboocwgZIDG-_Y3212yx8_v-zPdzH-_WBx-Xb7uhrh-XRmCgKBOUy3G2PhyjbGb9YPPAG9T8JvmgGAfZrFr1jMtZSAQclOi6ruvtA5hwIKyQD9d4fZoxwSVnqueqFdPgnO2V4B0fJieJZDj7mnJbV6z4scWFI70xt1PamqDXWp-FiC8ChoDZ972dgp9-YU2vUlM8KQIm4l4ImEtPwJyZBAwTBAw_T12xIHXplenF0Cm9YvVYqM1I7ZbiQuuK1NlSsVS65LT7uFAfr_dF54OAabKen7sPwZfuRiRbNuvDVbX-u91bw18AAAD__1KdcTQ).
| Flying together with our sponsor [](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0zztqwzAYAODTSFuMnrY1aAgUkSWBDk1HI-uVH2TLyMJJbl_avRf44Pu-TlcLGdZ0s0vQ7RXLxAiTJ8JPVEzeQn5PAns9E68oDpoOgipJKBP4oa0f--CHeeSRiSidkrPzUfajnckgo8OgfzHCqaBEjlR23KkY7Sg57alyUSBBgodWatceoYWX3WN-lyPUzpUFZ_1obdsRPyNmEDMJDlhT9yw1e1dWF-ralZoQM5tNATFjvm6f98v5fvkwuGq_PSFn2PsBCZIWC_lPbf82D81-AgAA__94LFTj) Somalia is facing a devastating combination of natural disasters, global conflicts, widespread poverty, and disease outbreaks. East Africa has just endured its worst drought in 40 years, leaving tens of millions without access to clean water, wiping out millions of livestock, and destroying crops. With domestic food production crippled, Somalia has relied heavily on imports—90% of its wheat coming from Russia and Ukraine—until those shipments stopped. Now, two in five children in Somalia suffer from acute malnutrition, and cholera is spreading in some regions. name: Kathryn Harvey
subject: Where is William Timmons?
body:
Welcome to my weekly newsletter

|
---
| **Welcome to Keeping Up with Kathryn Harvey. A weekly digest covering South Carolina politics and opportunities for engagement and action in the Upstate.**
---
|
# Where is William Timmons?
---
| Seriously—where _is_ he? Our congressman sits on the DOGE subcommittee, rubber-stamping every ruthless cut unelected bureaucrat Elon Musk has shoved through—gutting the VA, slashing the Department of Education, and throwing working families under the bus. And yet, he refuses to face the people he’s hurting. No Town Halls. No accountability. Just silence.
The damage from Medicaid cuts and tariffs will be devastating for our district. And Timmons? Nowhere to be found.
Enough. Join me **Saturday, March 15, at 2PM** at the Hughes Library in Greenville for a Town Hall hosted by Indivisible Upstate. **Call his office—(202) 225-6030—and demand he show up.** The people of this district deserve answers.
---

---

|

# Women and girls are worth fighting for.
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | I’ve spent my career standing up for women and girls. Not because it was easy— but because it was necessary.When I first stepped into this work, I didn’t know just how much it would shape me.
How much it would challenge me.
How much it would _matter_.Years ago, I had the extraordinary privilege of working on [girls empowerment ](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=4863a86337&e=edbde6c9b1)programs through Sesame Workshop —the global nonprofit behind Sesame Street. There, I poured my energy into supporting initiatives that gave young girls a voice—not just to sing or smile, but to be strong, to be curious, to lead, to dream big. Because I believed then—and still do—that when girls see themselves reflected, they start to believe in their power.Now I’m back in my home town of Spartanburg, South Carolina—a place I love deeply.
But let’s be honest: there’s work to do here. There are things happening in this state that deeply affect women—our choices, our bodies, our futures.And while I may not be working for women and girls around the globe anymore, I’m still fighting here at home with amazing organizations like the [Women’s Rights & Empowerment Network](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=7c8ddf034e&e=edbde6c9b1). Because there is still so much _worth fighting for_.This Women’s History Month, I’m reminded of the women who came before us—who marched, who taught, who healed, who built, who sacrificed.
And I’m reminded that history isn’t just something we read about.
It’s something we create—every single day.So, if you’re wondering whether your voice matters, whether your advocacy is too small, whether your presence can make a difference—let me tell you: it does.And we need you to stay in this fight.
---

It’s time for merit to make a comeback.

This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/s/c/2X6dyKwTjDg-iGms2p3jjLqK_EMtzY8w16VGbYV0bGajQ9bAiOpcQxreXw8SKur8gZ-lP1ngESFR1zXhFjAc2tpw9zllMKcfh1bZONygrFPZvJ_GXKfMwk28p7-eEEJ5-O4ZXRd1BSPMeL-liPL10wgbfPqxdJbQqTQh7BwW7uPpQ57NXMbyH8uiwFi04vZQMSX_5UVVe4tgxe-cM2Ake2ine5PrxGY2oOgv5kP74TbEEbBCqVu5AkaTXeXZp0xMBeOOJzPUzCwwhbEf17u9BOvmUmxnh1_xbb64oWTMQHJjFG_5BuHA4HUsMTiHxsG--1hXv3KVdHG0teafI4-t3oj6MtuQLyzWRkllkUnD0d-f_3LG73Y62JnJmvKXRDsdto6bEs0cNSznzlB0DXeO3xqaSo919jyAtyAdQSacMaBdXkiVnJaUiekK-SDPAA/0s73DOzCWiSk9XAcDD3Ho3ikc82sB3Aw/7)

Dear Friend of Liberty,

It's time for merit to make a comeback.

[That's why I'm writing to ask you to participate in Hillsdale College's **DEFEAT DEI SURVEY**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/s/c/_etBzWtV5Qun4A8iwrY4KY-_6I7pmrMYEIbFB08XMm4mmG7M_fTHOZw5bje3L56-mncdNFIQHOLq5Xkv-ksKlSUm2-16Sgb6Kqk8hPHwkhEzcyiKDR-MZH83FN_6vYsV6uDfT6cX811GaYq_6MQtqeQP4QnA2wZjbs6_9P5brBJevLFsRaoReVtGUGcSjbYxYWTgWBjDu3BXfv4SD-1JEP3fNyTtyUfNp6G5f4Ay0B0QARH_lWqubn9M9vgil0Uw55GWR-Zpt-dICTFH3xU1rlWBNOqc40XDkiqhjNm9vhak3QxopSQFebWjpbk6pBCIeV3JACfIpz7-WMQI2noTcGsSnacYMaGO65wHzRioHUl-DN7HuolyWopbBOqqwBLYStnXn01TCPLzjQma_hcVitylCqnkjU_dU25xiSInvu2DXNFp05F5cO-PRD8smg/XcIkUtzBoCqR3xIsSD0mZmg6sZohgPKy/7).

Like many Americans, I'm sure you're all too aware of the damage that has been done to our country by policies implemented in the name of "Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion" or "DEI."

Race grifters and hustlers make _millions_ perpetuating DEI lies, including...

* America is a nation built on slavery, not freedom.
* All racial disparities are indisputable evidence of systemic racism--and if you question this conclusion, you must be a racist.
* Students in K-12 schools can be divided into oppressors and oppressed based on their skin color.

DEI policies have infected almost every aspect of American life, from K-12 schools to college admissions and job applications. They have even spread into the hard sciences and the military.

These policies endanger lives and, ultimately, Western Civilization itself.

I'm sure, like a lot of Americans, you want to know what you can do to stop DEI. One of the most fundamental steps is ...

**Countering the far-Left ideologies that are being taught to students in K-12 schools, colleges, and universities.**

Hillsdale College, where I am president, is engaged in a nationwide fight on the battlefield of education to save young Americans from this anti-American agenda.

Since our founding in 1844, we have offered "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty."

To do this work well, we need a clear understanding of **what informed Americans like you think about DEI and how best to fight it.**

So please share your views by completing the **DEFEAT DEI SURVEY** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time.

Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept any government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations.

**We remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities have rejected their founding statements and embraced radical and dangerous ideologies.**

Please join Hillsdale College in our defense of Western Civilization by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **DEFEAT DEI SURVEY** , which you can access at this secure link:

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/defeat-dei-survey**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/s/c/vs1WD9sai_F5y-ajxT39ft09ttxqRQTuC7TCjCg1f8QSKmAKLvr8AA1OvfwsEQLfbWNlnCqwtCYtnB4CeY-pRRiu3iYj4aj0FZE3JlgMzXVhCwFhhfNOcAAXWNIitcDqsiJsgifD7XQsnqfwY0acFDp7qnEHtM-AVeDDAzRPU0O_PaMRrO0dbBH-ARhVi05-s4KvxYaVnDOEEYtc0NxaqUSwaCV_-GVh3Q7BymZeMZF18hNoCL2n7XUQtE-G9XWrQemypc-vp1jNKFeA5n4IK8_2MhEmKJwl2iakxWIvuhn2AFo1Pxv-3k5-zHs0b9NoJ1SQJTvUPXMNvfQOoavKTN-uhfBlg1TdEs9inr9p2gUbKXZTQI-0tsgazH2eog7flLUe7d1616h0qGTVtWen5V9MoxeL-L3Rhwbb-YKercSWZYbMVaoyQOZizbXOWg/T6ybS8z5Y-9wylpoEDDX7u1RpnfGP2tF/7)

With your help, we will continue our work to defeat the tyranny of low standards and to restore excellence in America.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S. Please fill out your **DEFEAT DEI SURVEY** today. Your answers will help us to defend excellence and merit against the tyranny of DEI. Today, DEI affects almost every aspect of American life. This endangers lives and, ultimately, Western Civilization itself.

You can take your survey at the secure link below. It will only take a few moments of your time.

[https://info.hillsdale.edu/defeat-dei-survey](https://links.conservativesgive.com/s/c/SguCLJ1xwd5619JoD-8xran_Iy_k_A_0JCcSBC40l8EZt-ug4tQN4HV7nQaaTf4wT-2tr2gRjVjGfExt6fSxa2u-AqMIxGgTXvtcbyNsCW4oOpfWHpMT1MMo2crxdu0Xa4Z6fFOpgo1jrmpB7zOeLNgwhmwwZULqRCcxdWUEuRzo1KXe9v5HbvlWLup3ngMvunxXFhLqWEO1Yf5Yw9ySWhOiy-RWjqB709DJICc36Efs5fissN_CJJD0ufJZ9S3uBejKeapxxsMSAO69r9TlhoRgwCKLr67pUtkdWfkqB0OhVJk3PA_XtbvNelmcY6spzVzpcVDLnXk_blw4g9Io0oCogLornPuk_AcoPlwUy0X1m-kFeQ9ImI1yhA17VEGGtB60aA3YVvtjTYo3hvopgsmbQ5YcmWwgtELYStLexu2oOehCE4m23NByG2TJ0Q/InfSIbJ7SKcR__W-vexBx6j_RokI-snw/7)

subject: Why there was a diaper shortage after WWII
body:
Living in America during World War II often meant going without everyday necessities.
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?xtl=1krv9cfc68dh4pblwm0hxwx344yt4i2ua5fluvy7jp8w7pk6i2j1ml185hmgwip6bopmo36wttmqj3g43nmt3npcitrwk3javmj9acm19xiiobc6i538c6tbgn6ebz9wvj3f5xcxw39avk7a5nru7fwp6&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st41mg&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
---
---
# [The baby boom caused a nationwide diaper shortage.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st41mg&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [U.S. History](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st41mg&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st41mg&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| L iving in America during World War II often meant going without everyday necessities. At the end of the war, ration restrictions were lifted, but the U.S. still found itself in short supply of a crucial item: diapers. The country was in the nascent stages of a postwar baby boom, and as the young population surged with soldiers returning home and starting families, cloth diaper production remained in its wartime slowdown.
---
Government agencies such as the War Production Board (WPB) denied the diaper shortage and said manufacturing was on pace to meet the demand. But textile insiders [said](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st41mg&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) otherwise, claiming that after the war, manufacturers had shifted looms away from diaper cloth to make more profitable cotton fabrics. The National Institute of Diaper Services [blamed](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st41mg&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) government officials who were not fathers and therefore didn’t understand infant needs, while retailers [said](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st41mg&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) shipments were not arriving quickly enough. On top of everything else, diaper prices were on the rise. Ultimately, frustrated parents and caregivers were left navigating the consequences.
The shortage wasn’t entirely unexpected. Diaper services — which, before the advent of disposables, collected soiled diapers and delivered fresh ones — were already under strain before the baby boom was in full swing. In 1943, wartime fuel rations made it difficult to run delivery trucks, and with many women working in war industries, fewer families had the time or resources to wash diapers at home. In June 1946, John K. Jones, president of the National Institute of Diaper Services, [introduced](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st41mg&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) a new folding technique in an attempt to help families cope with the ongoing shortage. Known today as the “kite fold,” it involved folding the corners of a diaper to create extra thickness in the center, making the diaper more absorbent and thus ideally able to last longer than a traditional triangle fold. The diaper shortage [made headlines](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st41mg&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) across the country for years, but by 1947, mention of it had tapered off.
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st41mg&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) | [](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st41mg&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

## Sugar was the first and last food rationed in the U.S. during World War II.
After the U.S. entered World War II, many goods, including food, were rationed to ensure military troops and manufacturers had enough supplies, and to enforce fair distribution among civilians. Sugar was the [first](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st41mg&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) food placed under rationing, mainly because of supply shortages: Before the war, the U.S. imported most of its sugar from the Philippines, but that supply was cut off after Japan occupied the islands in 1941. At the same time, cargo ships that once transported sugar were, like many things at the time, prioritized for military use. Even after the war ended in 1945, low crop yields and the rebuilding of trade networks meant that sugar remained in short supply. The U.S. government continued rationing sugar for two years, finally lifting restrictions in 1947 — making sugar not only the first but also the last food to be restricted during World War II.

clean_body: Living in America during World War II often meant going without everyday necessities. | L iving in America during World War II often meant going without everyday necessities. At the end of the war, ration restrictions were lifted, but the U.S. still found itself in short supply of a crucial item: diapers. The country was in the nascent stages of a postwar baby boom, and as the young population surged with soldiers returning home and starting families, cloth diaper production remained in its wartime slowdown. Government agencies such as the War Production Board (WPB) denied the diaper shortage and said manufacturing was on pace to meet the demand. But textile insiders otherwise, claiming that after the war, manufacturers had shifted looms away from diaper cloth to make more profitable cotton fabrics. The National Institute of Diaper Services government officials who were not fathers and therefore didn’t understand infant needs, while retailers shipments were not arriving quickly enough. On top of everything else, diaper prices were on the rise. Ultimately, frustrated parents and caregivers were left navigating the consequences. The shortage wasn’t entirely unexpected. Diaper services — which, before the advent of disposables, collected soiled diapers and delivered fresh ones — were already under strain before the baby boom was in full swing. In 1943, wartime fuel rations made it difficult to run delivery trucks, and with many women working in war industries, fewer families had the time or resources to wash diapers at home. In June 1946, John K. Jones, president of the National Institute of Diaper Services, a new folding technique in an attempt to help families cope with the ongoing shortage. Known today as the “kite fold,” it involved folding the corners of a diaper to create extra thickness in the center, making the diaper more absorbent and thus ideally able to last longer than a traditional triangle fold. The diaper shortage across the country for years, but by 1947, mention of it had tapered off. | By clicking a link in this email, you're agreeing to our and . By the Numbers | | Births in the U.S. in 1957, a peak baby boom year 4.3 million | | Year Valerie Hunter Gordon is credited with inventing disposable diapers 1947 | Year Valerie Hunter Gordon is credited with inventing disposable diapers 1947 | | Approximate cost per disposable diaper when Pampers launched in 1961 10¢ | | Percentage of fresh vegetables grown in U.S. victory gardens in 1944 40% | Percentage of fresh vegetables grown in U.S. victory gardens in 1944 40% | | | Did you know? ---|---|--- Sugar was the first and last food rationed in the U.S. during World War II. After the U.S. entered World War II, many goods, including food, were rationed to ensure military troops and manufacturers had enough supplies, and to enforce fair distribution among civilians. Sugar was the food placed under rationing, mainly because of supply shortages: Before the war, the U.S. imported most of its sugar from the Philippines, but that supply was cut off after Japan occupied the islands in 1941. At the same time, cargo ships that once transported sugar were, like many things at the time, prioritized for military use. Even after the war ended in 1945, low crop yields and the rebuilding of trade networks meant that sugar remained in short supply. The U.S. government continued rationing sugar for two years, finally lifting restrictions in 1947 — making sugar not only the first but also the last food to be restricted during World War II.
