name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: Building solidarity and staying the course / Construyendo solidaridad y manteniendo el rumbo
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
📱 MAKE CALLS WITH US 📱
Keep up the pressure against bad bills in our legislature
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Texas%20Capitol%20Austin%20building.jpg]
Texas Republicans are shamelessly seeking to gut our civil liberties this legislative session with their majority in Austin. GOP state senators in the Senate Committee on Criminal Justice last month passed pieces of legislation — SJR5 and SB9 — that further chip away at our fundamental rights and our access to justice. We still have time to combat these bad bills in the Texas House, but we need your help NOW.
Join us in making calls! Let’s send a message that ALL who call our state home deserve to have their full rights respected!
LIKE and SHARE this Facebook post to contact your state representative and spread the word. [https://www.facebook.com/OrganizeTexas/posts/pfbid0nr2fXTwsyx2L1gPQQhLRo6bCqAjph1ZNPURpPpyg3467TH97f53p2ywSm7RwehNbl]
For more information on how to get involved in TOP's efforts to combat these bad legislative proposals and more, email Laquita at lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] .
ADD YOUR NAME:
Speak out against Medicaid cuts in Congress
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Megaphone%20pic.png]
We're entering a critical period for the future of Medicaid for children, pregnant women, seniors, and people with disabilities.
Now that the U.S. House has passed a budget resolution to kick off the legislative process, House and Senate leaders are negotiating next steps with each other and their respective members. Drastic cuts to Medicaid are unacceptably at the forefront of these discussions.
This means we must raise our voices and call on Congress to oppose Medicaid cuts! We join our allies at Cover Texas Now and Sick Of It Texas in urging ALL Texans to send an email to your members of Congress.
TAKE ACTION HERE. [https://covertexasnow.org/take-action]
For more information about TOP's healthcare justice work, email Irie at ihoward@organizetexas.org [ihoward@organizetexas.org] .
NEXT WEEK:
Dallas County TOP housing justice meet-up
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Dallas%20housing%20action%20-%20Meadows%20at%20Ferguson.jpg]
TOP's Dallas County Housing Justice campaign is gearing up to have a bigger impact this year to protect the rights of local tenants.
Join us at our next campaign meeting on March 19 from 5 - 7 p.m. at the Dallas TOP office (3910 Gaston Ave., Ste. 250) where we'll break bread and plan out our campaign organizing efforts for the coming months.
Come drop by to find out how you can be part of our work! For more information, contact Iman at ibouzid@organizetexas.org [ibouzid@organizetexas.org] .
TOP Tip: Get our Women's History Month Mixtape on Spotify
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/2025%20TOP%20WHM.png]
Women inspire, women lead, and women manifest. We've been the backbone of every movement for societal progress over the course of history, and we're not stopping. As TOP recognizes Women’s History Month this March, we encourage you to check out our Women’s History Month Mixtape [https://open.spotify.com/playlist/4uW9pkLvoV3hU8HjvAxvKI] and give us a follow on Spotify [https://open.spotify.com/user/2kq0bkf1efxxm6wbvfwmgpu0f] !
Español
📱 HAZ LLAMADAS CON NOSOTROS 📱
Mantengamos la presión contra los proyectos de ley negativos en nuestra legislatura
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Texas%20Capitol%20Austin%20building.jpg]
Los republicanos de Texas buscan descaradamente socavar nuestras libertades civiles en esta sesión legislativa, con su mayoría en Austin. El mes pasado, los senadores estatales republicanos del Comité Senatorial de Justicia Penal aprobaron leyes — SJR5 y SB9 — que socavan aún más nuestros derechos fundamentales y nuestro acceso a la justicia. Aún tenemos tiempo para combatir estas malas propuestas legislativas en la Cámara de Representantes de Texas, pero necesitamos su ayuda YA.
¡Únase a nosotros para hacer llamamientos! Enviemos el mensaje de que TODOS los que consideran nuestro estado su hogar merecen que se respeten sus derechos.
Pulse ME GUSTA y COMPARTA esta publicación de Facebook para contactar a su representante estatal y difundir el mensaje. [https://www.facebook.com/OrganizeTexas/posts/pfbid0nr2fXTwsyx2L1gPQQhLRo6bCqAjph1ZNPURpPpyg3467TH97f53p2ywSm7RwehNbl]
Para obtener más información sobre cómo participar en los esfuerzos de TOP para combatir estas malas propuestas legislativas y más, envíe un correo electrónico a Laquita a lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] .
FIRMA AHORA:
Alza la voz contra los recortes a Medicaid en el Congreso
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Megaphone%20pic.png]
Estamos entrando en un período crítico para el futuro de Medicaid para niños, mujeres embarazadas, adultos mayores y personas con discapacidad.
Ahora que la Cámara de Representantes de EE. UU. aprobó una resolución presupuestaria para iniciar el proceso legislativo, los líderes de la Cámara y el Senado están negociando los próximos pasos entre sí y con sus respectivos miembros. Los recortes a Medicaid son, inaceptablemente, el tema principal de estas discusiones.
Esto significa que debemos alzar la voz y pedir al Congreso que se oponga a los recortes a Medicaid. Nos unimos a nuestros aliados de Cover Texas Now y Sick Of It Texas para instar a TODOS los tejanos a enviar un correo electrónico a sus congresistas.
ACTÚA AQUÍ. [https://covertexasnow.org/take-action]
Para obtener más información sobre el trabajo de TOP por la justicia en la atención médica, escriba a Irie a ihoward@organizetexas.org [ihoward@organizetexas.org] .
PRÓXIMA SEMANA:
Reunión de la campaña TOP por la justicia en la vivienda del condado de Dallas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Dallas%20housing%20action%20-%20Meadows%20at%20Ferguson.jpg]

body:
CO AG Weiser on DOJ’s review of Tina Peters’ case: “Grotesque attempt to weaponize the rule of law”
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Happy Friday,
Here is a summary of today's top stories:
**🏛️ Colorado Legislative Session Updates...** Lawmakers, media, and watchdogs are battling over [public records access](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) after a GOP bill to close a transparency loophole was blocked, with advocates now pushing for a ballot measure. Meanwhile, a proposal to [let charter schools open](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in struggling districts without school board approval is fueling the school choice debate.
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** AG Phil Weiser condemned the [DOJ’s review of Tina Peters’ case](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) as a “grotesque” politicization of law. Rep. Gabe Evans introduced the [BELOS Act](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to support military families. Colorado’s rising health care costs for undocumented immigrants are [straining state resources](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). DOGE plans to cut [$9.4 million in leases](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in Colorado.
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** An FBI task force [arrested 214 criminals](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), including MS-13 and Tren de Aragua members, in a crackdown on organized crime. A federal judge ordered Trump to [reinstate unlawfully fired probationary federal employees](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). State attorneys general finalized a plan to challenge Google’s [search engine monopoly](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
This is the Mountain Minute for Friday, March 14, 2025. Don't forget to to listen to our new **Mountain Minute Podcast** , every morning! Click [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[CO AG Weiser on DOJ’s review of Tina Peters’ case: “Grotesque attempt to weaponize the rule of law”](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
The DOJ is now reviewing whether federal agencies engaged in politically motivated lawfare in the high-profile case of former Mesa County Clerk Tina Peters. In response to the DOJ’s filing, Colorado Attorney General Phil Weiser urged the Denver federal court to reject its interference.
The DOJ’s recent move to review Peters’ prosecution for “political bias” is a rare and unprecedented step, leading many to question whether this is a genuine concern for justice or simply an attempt to suppress dissent.
Peters was sentenced to nine years behind bars for actions related to the forensic imaging of Mesa County’s election management system in 2021.
The mainstream narrative has painted her as a criminal, but the DOJ’s sudden interest in reviewing her case suggests that even the Trump Administration sees flaws in the process that led to her conviction.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
The Rocky Mountain Voice is a 501(c)(3) that exists to promote informed civic engagement and the principles of self-governance through enterprise reporting on public policy, politics, government, and culture throughout the state of Colorado. The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Who gets to know? Lawmakers, media and watchdogs wrangle over public records access](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* A Republican-led bill to repeal a loophole that allows lawmakers to bypass public meetings laws was killed in committee, reinforcing concerns about reduced government transparency.
* Advocacy groups, including government watchdogs and media organizations, are now pushing for a 2026 ballot initiative to strengthen public records access and close legislative secrecy gaps.
* Proposed legislation could further delay public records requests, while high fees for accessing government documents continue to make transparency costly and difficult for citizens.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Congressman Gabe Evans introduces BELOS Act to support military families](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Rep. Gabe Evans introduced the bipartisan BELOS Act, which would provide free lifetime National Park passes to families of service members who passed away due to service-related illness or injury.
* Co-sponsored by Rep. Jimmy Panetta (D-CA), the bill has been referred to the House Natural Resources and Agriculture Committees and is gaining traction in Congress.
* Named after First Sergeant Marc Belo, a decorated soldier and 9/11 first responder, the bill seeks to ensure Gold Star families and those who lost loved ones to service-related causes receive lasting recognition and benefits.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[DOGE is terminating $9.4M in leases across Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX 31 NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) is terminating over $9.4 million in federal leases across Colorado, affecting 355,000 square feet of office, warehouse, and parking space.
* This move is part of a broader effort by DOGE to reduce government spending, with over 4,000 contract terminations and nearly $15 billion in savings reported nationwide.
* The lease terminations impact various federal agencies, including the National Park Service, Geological Survey, and Social Security Administration.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
** ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
**[House Democrats push “most outrageous” SB25-003 forward after 12-hour hearing](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY RMV STAFF | STATE | MARCH 12** _The sheriff in town may be tasked with the administrative burden of weighing in on your future firearm purchase, if Democrat lawmakers have their say. Although sheriffs from El Paso, Lake, Mesa and Weld counties testified that Senate Bill 25-003 is both unconstitutional and difficult to enforce, the House Judiciary Committee advanced the legislation after twelve hours of testimony._ __
**[Taxed and voiceless: How a debt trap turned Meadows Metro District residents into an ATM for bondholders](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY JEN SCHUMANN | LOCAL | MARCH 12** _Imagine paying a $200 tax each month for a community infrastructure project that was completed decades ago. To add insult to injury, consider being told that you’ll continue doing so for 100 years._ __
**[Mesa County Commissioner advocates for fair share of transportation dollars](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY LINDY BROWNING****| LOCAL | MARCH 12** _With an ever shrinking budget, and an ever increasing demand for state money for road repairs and construction due to increasing population and use on the Western Slope, Mesa County Commissioner, Bobbie Daniels went to the state legislature to put a spotlight on the needs of western Colorado._

body:

|

---
Well Sourced
Welcome to MAHA’s Well Sourced, the newsletter where you can stay informed on all things MAHA, including the latest on the issues, The MAHA Podcast, updates, and more.
[FULL NEWSLETTER](https://www.mahaaction.com/newsletter-edition-1?e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=well_sourced_march_1_2025_9&n=2)
| |

| [ ](https://www.mahaaction.com?e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=well_sourced_march_1_2025_9&n=3) | Nomination Hearings Abound!
---|---
Na,
Our mission to _Make America Healthy Again_ is full speed ahead!
Dr. Jay Bhattacharya [testified on March 5](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=ecbTWdb_9-KtUqkP1flx8N8F2fuDBVSxpQVq3X6LeGIQDoKgopPNTgD6raGVI_shqaHcP-plx_ppaG3H5nBQwcHQovhaTykkdw3pixDOKoPgeKR5AVuCRnhTj3sEAguM4-3kZPuS_lxw8WZg5rEnWPUddkonDWc969bhJy6Lm1-j7x2NuO_4nnyGpU1266Q_&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=well_sourced_march_1_2025_9&n=4) for NIH Director, exposing the agency’s culture of cover-ups and intolerance for dissent. He’s committed to restoring real science, refocusing NIH on chronic diseases, and fostering open debate—where young scientists can challenge the status quo. With RFK Jr. in his corner, he’s ready to make NIH a powerhouse for freedom and health.
Dr. Marty Makary, nominated for FDA Commissioner, [testified on March 6](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=ecbTWdb_9-KtUqkP1flx8N8F2fuDBVSxpQVq3X6LeGIQDoKgopPNTgD6raGVI_shzK3TZ38kz-P_NW07yEN9NFuajcs0LyBw9PEHzI4GV4TzNHrVLfAcbOcpsD6NSpbXs9V5Lt7PD0PLJSeKJK2_8Q&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=well_sourced_march_1_2025_9&n=5). He vowed to uphold the scientific process and push back against bureaucratic overreach. He highlighted the hypocrisy in flu vs. COVID vaccine standards, the need for food as medicine, and breaking pharma’s patent stranglehold on essential ingredients. His bottom line? True medical excellence comes from humility and a willingness to learn.
These hearings weren’t just formalities; they were a battle cry for MAHA. Dr. Bhattacharya and Dr. Makary are ready to reform these agencies to serve us, the people. They’re not afraid to question the so-called experts or take on the tough fights—like chronic disease and overreach—that have been ignored for far too long. We’re on the cusp of something huge. Let’s keep the momentum going!
| |
---
| [ ](https://www.mahaaction.com?e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=well_sourced_march_1_2025_9&n=6) | Read
---|---
The MAHA Nutrition Committee
Why are we feeding our most vulnerable—our children—the most toxic “food” available?
The MAHA Nutrition Committee is on a mission to redefine dietary guidelines and push for better school lunch programs in all 50 states. By working with experts, we will identify healthy alternatives—eliminating seed oils, chemical additives, and GMOs—and present them to legislators for real policy change.
Beyond schools, we’ll advocate for healthier food in hospitals and nursing homes, where proper nutrition is critical for healing.
MAHA Action believes fixing our food system is key to reversing rising rates of obesity, chronic disease, and diabetes. [It’s time to take action.](https://www.mahaaction.com/petition-chemicals?e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=well_sourced_march_1_2025_9&n=7)
[](https://www.mahaaction.com?e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=well_sourced_march_1_2025_9&n=8)
| [ ](https://www.mahaaction.com?e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=well_sourced_march_1_2025_9&n=9) | Act
---|---
They're Making America _Sick_ Again
A chemical company is trying to dodge responsibility for causing cancer—and worse, its toxic chemical, glyphosate, is showing up in our food, water, and even rain.
The company, Bayer Monsanto, is pushing for state-level immunity across the US, and is asking Congress for immunity in this year’s Farm Bill.
This means that you and your family would be blocked from suing Bayer Monsanto if their product harmed or killed your child.
**We need your help.** Our kids and communities deserve clean food, water, and an environment free from toxic chemicals. Corporations that knowingly poison us to protect their profits must be stopped.
[Sign the petition now to hold them accountable.](https://www.mahaaction.com/petition-end-chemical-co-immunity?e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=well_sourced_march_1_2025_9&n=10)
[](https://www.mahaaction.com?e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=well_sourced_march_1_2025_9&n=11)
| [ ](https://www.mahaaction.com?e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=well_sourced_march_1_2025_9&n=12) | Watch
---|---
**The MAHA Podcast is here** —delivering the most groundbreaking, unfiltered, and revelatory conversations about health, freedom, and the forces shaping our future.
In our debut episode, **Del Bigtree** sits down with **Dr. Robert Redfield** , former CDC Director and one of the most influential voices in pandemic response. What he reveals exposes the cracks in our entire health system—from COVID cover-ups to the shocking truth about vaccine safety.
[](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=1AJnCcoGtHYftrUTYBwtFAnrT6otfJHYuxXn9IkEPCgcwWveExsAIsy_PJ5AHoia&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=well_sourced_march_1_2025_9&n=13)
[](https://www.mahaaction.com?e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=well_sourced_march_1_2025_9&n=14)
| [ ](https://www.mahaaction.com?e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=well_sourced_march_1_2025_9&n=15) | Trending
---|---
Texas Measles Outbreak – HHS Shifts Focus to Nutrition
A measles outbreak in Texas has prompted a shift in the CDC’s approach under HHS. Clinicians are now advised to consider nutrition and Vitamin A as part of treatment.
In a March 2 op-ed, Secretary Robert F. Kennedy reiterated his campaign message: vaccines are available, but so are therapeutics. Proper diet and physician-guided Vitamin A use can significantly reduce disease mortality.
Read more about this holistic approach in the updated CDC guidance [[here]](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=IGdGkSTmqeqwNnjWiNfgmkFdJ4hmWIbUqnMiq71dUE-TRgrIGBnstKvj8hGwe6tuaZ9bXLfDkF6xcMJuRpPPyg&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=well_sourced_march_1_2025_9&n=16).
***
CDC Halts Flu Vaccine Campaign, Key Meetings Canceled
The CDC has pulled funding from its **Wild to Mild** campaign, launched to combat vaccine hesitancy during the 2023-2024 flu season. HHS has now shut it down—along with key advisory meetings.
The Flu Vaccine Advisory Panel meeting, set for March 13, was canceled, as was the ACIP meeting, which guides vaccine recommendations.
Read more on the impact [[here]](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=UXPuHEIEW8V_pNSskuhFANWqTscSvG2YidR8WFFYZVMN7aENuquZNmkbRuH9rp-xFtxCQFftso6vYNZQ4W0IoygskopoJUXxs8ibmP9XXSw&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=well_sourced_march_1_2025_9&n=17).
[](https://www.mahaaction.com?e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=well_sourced_march_1_2025_9&n=18)
| Quote of the week:
---
“Ultimately, what makes a great doctor is not how much you know. It’s your humility and your willingness to learn as you go from patients.”—Dr. Marty Makary

Taking a few minutes out of your busy day to participate in the survey will help unite the Republican Party and fine-tune our agenda in crucial battleground states all around the country.

| | | | Friends,

This week, we recognize the power of service and leadership: from millions of AmeriCorps volunteers who have strengthened our communities since 1994 to the principled veteran lawmakers standing with Ukraine.
---
|
---
| **Honoring Service During #AmeriCorpsWeek**
Since 1994, over 1.3 million AmeriCorps members have dedicated more than 1.9 billion hours to strengthening communities across the country. National service programs like AmeriCorps foster civic engagement, strengthen communities, and create pathways to leadership, values that align deeply with the mission of With Honor Action.

➡ As With Honor Action CEO Rye Barcott highlighted at the 30th Anniversary Conference for AmeriCorps:
“ _Service will save us._ ” – Gov. Wes Moore
---
| [ ](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=570af921b6&e=33f53a5b1a)
---
| ➡ This #AmeriCorpsWeek, we celebrate those who serve and advocate for a future where service remains a cornerstone of our democracy.

🔗 Click [here](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=779fae89e7&e=33f53a5b1a) to learn more about With Honor Action’s work to support AmeriCorps

🔗 Click [here](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=30c35888cc&e=33f53a5b1a) to hear more stories about how AmeriCorps benefits all Americans

---
|
---
| **From AmeriCorps to the Coast Guard: A Legacy of Service**
---
|
---
Soldiers assigned to the 36th Engineer Brigade, load their vehicles with supplies from the American Red Cross and the help of volunteers from AmeriCorps National Civilian Community Corps in response to Hurricane Harvey. Courtesy of the U.S. Army (Matthew Keeler).
| Commander Michael Russell spent 26 years in the U.S. Coast Guard, but his journey of service began in AmeriCorps. His story exemplifies how national service builds leaders ready for duty, whether in military service, public leadership, or community engagement.

➡ As we celebrate #AmeriCorpsWeek, Commander Russell’s journey highlights:

⭐️ The strong bond of service shared by many Americans.
⭐️ How national service prepares individuals for leadership.
⭐️ The need to expand opportunities for more Americans to serve their country.

📖 Read more about Commander Russell’s story here: [U.S. Naval Institute's _Proceedings_](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=769f987e49&e=33f53a5b1a)
---
|
---
| **Ukraine Webinar: Standing with Our Allies**
This week, With Honor Action’s Co-Founder and CEO Rye Barcott hosted a webinar to discuss the ongoing Russian invasion of Ukraine, bipartisan work in Congress over the past three years of the conflict, and a path forward through and alongside the principled veteran leadership of members of the For Country Caucus.

With special guests:
🇺🇸 Rep. Don Bacon – Founding Co-Chair of the For Country Caucus and U.S. Air Force veteran.
🇺🇸 Rep. Don Davis – Current Co-Chair of the For Country Caucus and U.S. Air Force veteran.
🇺🇦 MP Oleksandra “Sasha” Ustinova – Member of the Ukrainian Parliament
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
| At With Honor Action, we believe that service is the foundation of a stronger, more unified nation. As we reflect on AmeriCorps Week, and the ongoing fight for democracy in Ukraine, we are reminded that leadership grounded in service is essential in overcoming today’s challenges.

Thank you for standing with us in support of those who have served and are still serving in the military, in Congress, in AmeriCorps, and beyond.

Here is the truth:
📍States with strong gun laws have lower rates of gun violence and violent crime per capita than states with weak gun laws.
📈 After the Assault Weapons Ban passed by Congress expired, mass shooting deaths skyrocketed.
📉 After Joe Biden signed the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act into law, violent crime plummeted to a 50-year low.
Time after time we see strong gun laws save lives. We see it in America, and we see it in other countries that do not have the epidemic of gun violence we have here.
Now we have an administration hell-bent on dismantling laws that make our communities safer. We saw the result during Trump's first term, when gun homicides rose by 34%.
With everything going on right now, we know gun violence isn't a top-of-mind issue for everyone. But it is top-of-mind for the gun lobby and the folks inside the Trump administration.
GIFFORDS is one of the few organizations working every day to make our communities safer from gun violence. We do the work when the issue is in the news, and we do it when other issues get more attention.

name: Tim Kaine
subject: Trump and Musk are gutting our education system. Speak out with me →
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kaine for Virginia
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025]
Derek —
This week, President Trump and Elon Musk fired more than a thousand employees of the Department of Education — nearly half its workforce.
Let’s be clear: This will hurt every student across the country. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/3SnMOWzfa0GsG7rYA2PCDw2]
https://secure.ngpvan.com/3SnMOWzfa0GsG7rYA2PCDw2 [https://secure.ngpvan.com/3SnMOWzfa0GsG7rYA2PCDw2]
One of the things that makes America great is our long history of being at the forefront of innovation and economic opportunity — and that’s in large part because of our strong public education system!
Now thanks to Trump and Musk, we can expect longer processing times for student financial aid, even more problems disbursing funding for K-12 schools, and reduced oversight of programs for students with disabilities and laws regarding sexual assault on college campuses.
These mass firings are an absolutely terrible decision, and moving forward with an executive order to fully close the Department of Education would be even worse.
There is no path for America to continue leading the world in the 21st century if the Trump Administration continues to lay waste to our education system.
I will do everything in my power to protect Virginia’s federal employees at the Education Department and the students, parents, and educators they serve — and today I’m asking for your help.
A strong public outcry can make a difference. We’ve seen this in action with the funding freeze and the absurd firing of national park workers, and we need to keep it going.
Will you add your name to my public petition in support of the Department of Education? A major showing of grassroots support is an important lever right now. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/3SnMOWzfa0GsG7rYA2PCDw2]
Thank you for speaking out with me.
-Tim Kaine

GOP Rep. John James **[dismantled CBS's Margaret Brennan during a live interview](https://substack.com/redirect/178cbae2-6595-409b-a687-0a7fc68f5e20?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for fear mongering about President Trump's tariff negotiation strategy.
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/178cbae2-6595-409b-a687-0a7fc68f5e20?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Brennan asked James about a statement from the CEO of Ford, who claimed "a 25% tariff would blow a hole in U.S. industry that we have never seen."
James fired back, "You can talk to the CEO of Ford but what I'm dealing with is people when I visit factory floors every single day!"
**["When you're not playing fair with America,](https://substack.com/redirect/178cbae2-6595-409b-a687-0a7fc68f5e20?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** then we have to do what we can to make sure that we can compete on a fair playing field," James added. "Fairness is what we should be pursuing, and I don't think that's wrong to ask for from our allies and partners!"
James reminded Brennan before she asked her next question, that he has a masters degree in supply chain economics and is a businessman in the automatic industry.
"What I'm trying to say is, the cars go across the border multiple times," Brennan stated. "What is the construction of the tariffs that is actually going to be beneficial here?!"
"You know what else comes across the border?" James asked. "Fentanyl!"
Watch the fiery interview on "Face The Nation"

Hi friends,

I don't know about you, but I'm pretty eager for new voices and new leadership within the Democratic Party - and beyond.

If you sound like every other politician who got us here, I don't want to hear it.

This isn't ideological for me; passion and authenticity resonate with me whether it's from a democratic socialist like AOC or a CEO like Mark Cuban.

One of those new voices that has impressed me when he has visited us here in NH is Congressman Ro Khanna. Anyone who both co-chaired Bernie's campaign and represents Silicon Valley turns my head. I thought you might be interested, too and I love the energy of his announcement he will be showing up in red districts to bring this fight to life [https://bsky.app/profile/rokhanna.bsky.social/post/3ljlzaq6dbk2b] :

Plenty of our ancestors faced harder odds, with less freedom than we have today, and won. Let's keep pushing, searching for new voices and new leaders, and persisting.

Thanks,
Colin

This dangerous bill needs to be stopped before bad actors are empowered to weaponize the tax code against organizations they don't agree with. | | | Team: Ignore the Teslas on the south lawn of the White House and pay attention to the words. Why? When we called out a frightening bill, last known as H.R. 9495, that already passed the House and would give President Donald Trump broad powers to target his political foes, a lot of our supporters replied that the bill would only truly apply to terrorist groups and that we were overreacting. Well, yesterday, right outside the White House, President Trump said people vandalizing Tesla brand cars would be branded domestic terrorists and "go through hell." We're not condoning vandalism, but it shows how quickly and abruptly Donald Trump will escalate against people he sees as his opponents. So we ask again -- what would stop President Trump from doing the same to nonprofits like ours? We have to defend the freedom of speech and our right to protest wrongs against us. If you've saved your payment information with FastAction, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | | To refresh your memory, this so-called "nonprofit killer" bill would empower the Treasury secretary to unilaterally designate any nonprofit as a “terrorist supporting organization” and revoke its tax-exempt status, effectively killing the group. The bill could give presidential administrations a tool to crack down on organizations for political reasons. “ Authoritarianism is not born overnight — it creeps in ,” Rep. Lloyd Doggett said on the House floor. “ A tyrant tightens his grip not just by seizing power, but when he demands new powers and when those who can stop him willingly cede and bend to his will.”“ A sixth grader would know this is unconstitutional ,” added Rep. Jamie Raskin. Unconstitutional and authoritarian or not, this bill has passed the House once and has a good chance of passing both houses of Congress now that opponents of voting rights have total control of our government. That's why we're working now to prevent this bill from ever becoming law. | | | | | | | ---|---|---|--- Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities. At a rally one month ago Schumer screamed into a microphone, "_We will fight, and we will win! We will fight, and we will win_!" This week, he is betraying the entire Democratic Party base and voting with Republicans to fund Trump and Musk's corrupt administration, handing them a lifeline to continue devastating our nation.
Earlier this week former Congresswoman [Marie Newman](https://open.substack.com/users/108375358-marie-newman?utm_source=mentions) and I co-authored a piece asking whether Americans need [a changed Democratic Party or a new third party altogether](https://substack.com/redirect/4b87dd96-a7e6-499f-a663-7ea5cccdf053?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)? Not 48 hours passed before Democratic Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer proved the point for us.
This is not leadership. This is cowardice. It's one big reason why the Democratic Party keeps losing. And until we change leadership, or the Democratic Party changes altogether, it will continue to lose. It does not have to be this way, and here's what we as voters must do to fight back. **Let 's Address This.**
**More than 123,000 activists have subscribed to** _**Let 's Address This.** _**We are doing everything in our power to stave off fascism in the United States. Subscribe and join us.**

Aspiring autocrat Donald Trump (Left) and Senate Minority Leader bent on empowering said autocrat, Chuck Schumer (Right). Photo Credit: Getty Images
## Voters - Take Action ASAP
Before diving into the crux of the problem, I am leading this article with the clear and easy call to action to maximize participation. We can still stop the GOP funding bill if we demand accountability and force Democrats to act. I am hopeful we can get tens of thousands of calls to Democratic Senators to hold the line against the GOP.
**🚨 Call These Senators & Demand They Vote NO on the GOP's Funding Bill:**
_📞 Each number starts with (202) 224-_
📍 Schumer - 6542
📍 Hassan - 3324
📍 Peters - 6221
📍 Durbin - 2152
📍 Schatz - 3934
📍 King - 5344
📍 Shaheen - 2841
📍 Fetterman - 4254
📍 Cortez Masto - 3542
📍 Gillibrand - 4451
**Here 's a simple sample script to follow:**

Hi, my name is [Your Name], and I'm calling to demand Senator [Name] VOTE NO on the GOP funding bill. This bill gifts Trump and Musk a free pass, abandons working families, and lets the GOP escape blame for their failures. Americans are struggling, we're angry, and we need fighters--not cowards. We Oppose This Horrible Bill.

Will the Senator stand with us or sell us out? We're watching, and we won't forget. Thank you.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2550223&post_id=159060582&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTU5MDYwNTgyLCJpYXQiOjE3NDE5NjQ4OTEsImV4cCI6MTc0NDU1Njg5MSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTI1NTAyMjMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.IEr0gGJc9Ap4nwOYkkOdU9WiDj9UlKX2VMwBS1kCWSc)
### We Are Not Helpless--But Schumer is Making Us Weaker
Let's be clear: MAGAs control the House, the Senate, and the White House. The Democratic Party is not in its strongest position, and every single day Trump and Musk are working to gut democracy, attack working families, and consolidate power.
And yet, when given the opportunity to use _the one piece leverage_ Democrats have--forcing Republicans to own the government shutdown--Schumer is folding like a cardboard box in a rainstorm. The American people are begging Senate Democrats to reject the GOP's grotesque funding bill. House Democrats are united in voting against it. The majority of Senate Democratic are demanding Schumer hold the line. Rather than force Republicans to own their failure and thus negotiate in good faith with Democrats, Schumer is throwing the American people under the bus and aligning with the very people he claimed he would "fight against and win."
And he's doing so with justifications so bizarre they defy comprehension.
**If you 're finding value in this article, please consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.**
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..qwSkBX4UBY0-5wpVTeYWdmqWZ-k1od_xslMADqZdcLQ?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=159060582)
## Schumer Thinks Capitulation is a Strategy--It's Not. It's Failure.
What is Schumer's justification to vote with Republicans now? He claims kicking the can down the road is the right move because, "_Trump will be unpopular in six months, and then Republicans will be forced to negotiate in good faith_."
Really? Maybe Schumer needs a reminder of the past 4 years alone.
* Trump was convicted of tax fraud. His company was found liable for decades of corruption. It did not diminish his popularity.
* Trump incited an insurrection. He tried to overthrow the U.S. government. He then pardoned the white supremacists and Nazis (including the guy who wore the grotesquely antisemitic "Camp Auschwitz" shirt). It did not diminish his popularity.
* Trump was found liable for sexual assault. A judge and jury in a civil trial ruled him a rapist as per the textbook definition of the word. It did not diminish his popularity.
* Oh, and he's absolutely pro Nazi salutes, viciously antisemitic, Islamophobic, racist, and misogynistic, and overtly xenophobic against non-white immigrants.

Even right now with the stock market crashing, a global trade war rising, and inflation and unemployment increasing, Trump is still more popular than Democrats and certainly more popular than Chuck Schumer. Given all of the above, why on earth does Schumer think that giving Trump even more time, more money, and more power is the right move?
This isn't just betrayal. It's utter incompetence.
Charlie Schumer is Charlie Brown, the Republicans are Lisa, the football is the GOP's faux deal, and Chuck is yet again falling for it. It's become painfully routine, and the American people are paying the price.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5649e2df-5034-430c-997a-dce18519be39?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And ultimately here's the point that Schumer seems to think the American people don't realize. By voting with Republicans, he is handing Trump and Musk a budget bill with no limit on where and how they can spend funds. On what planet is giving trillions of dollars to two unaccountable billionaires a good idea? It is absolute lunacy.
## The Democratic Party Has a Choice: Fight, or Step Aside
Finally, for those alleging Schumer doesn't speak for the party, let's be clear:
1. Schumer is literally the Democratic Senate Leader. His actions define the party.
2. If Senate Democrats truly found this betrayal objectionable, they'd remove him. They won't. They are complicit. It is both uncomfortable and wholly necessary to acknowledge this fact.

We don't need more politicians holding tiny signs and coordinating outfits while Trump consolidates power and enables fascism. We need leadership with the courage to fight injustice and hold the line when it matters.
But until that happens, we as voters are not helpless and we cannot give up. We can still raise our voices and demand action and accountability. I encourage each person reading this to not only call each of the above Senate Democrats, but also share this piece with your network and encourage them to call as well. And if you're near Schumer's office, pay him a visit as the young people below are this morning.
Schumer may have surrendered, but we still have power. Let's use it.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/aabcddfa-bb0a-47b1-a7ef-ec1d3978a634?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Young people are sitting in at Senator Schumer's office to demand he stop the GOP's corrupt budget. Photo Credit: Sunrise Movement

## Conclusion
Over the past month I've received thousands of message from lifelong Democrats saying the Democratic Party's capitulation and weakness in the face of Trump has convinced them to leave the party altogether. People are fed up with cowardice, and Democratic Party still refuses to listen.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ace96fae-c7ce-4eaa-b9fb-5bada21986c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
History will remember Mitch McConnell and Charlie ~~Brown~~ Schumer as the two US Senators most effective in getting things done for the _Republican_ Party. And that's the fundamental problem. It's clear that whatever the outcome of this budget fight, Chuck Schumer is not the person to lead the Democratic Party. He should resign, and Senate Democrats should elect a new Senate leader--one who will not bow to Trump's fascism, and one who will actually fight for America's working people. Otherwise, the Democratic Party will continue to bleed supporters, and continue to lose to fascists.
The American people are exhausted. We cannot afford another moment of weakness.
The time for excuses is over. Fight, step aside, or be replaced.
**The fight to stave off fascism under this new regime is growing. I cannot do it alone. Subscribe below and join the movement.**

I am hopeful we can get tens of thousands of calls to Democratic Senators to hold the line against the GOP. 🚨 Call These Senators & Demand They Vote NO on the GOP's Funding Bill: 📞 Each number starts with (202) 224- 📍 Schumer - 6542 📍 Hassan - 3324 📍 Peters - 6221 📍 Durbin - 2152 📍 Schatz - 3934 📍 King - 5344 📍 Shaheen - 2841 📍 Fetterman - 4254 📍 Cortez Masto - 3542 📍 Gillibrand - 4451 Here 's a simple sample script to follow: Hi, my name is [Your Name], and I'm calling to demand Senator [Name] VOTE NO on the GOP funding bill. This bill gifts Trump and Musk a free pass, abandons working families, and lets the GOP escape blame for their failures. Americans are struggling, we're angry, and we need fighters--not cowards. We Oppose This Horrible Bill. Will the Senator stand with us or sell us out? We're watching, and we won't forget. Thank you. We Are Not Helpless--But Schumer is Making Us Weaker Let's be clear: MAGAs control the House, the Senate, and the White House. The Democratic Party is not in its strongest position, and every single day Trump and Musk are working to gut democracy, attack working families, and consolidate power. And yet, when given the opportunity to use the one piece leverage Democrats have--forcing Republicans to own the government shutdown--Schumer is folding like a cardboard box in a rainstorm. The American people are begging Senate Democrats to reject the GOP's grotesque funding bill. House Democrats are united in voting against it. The majority of Senate Democratic are demanding Schumer hold the line. Rather than force Republicans to own their failure and thus negotiate in good faith with Democrats, Schumer is throwing the American people under the bus and aligning with the very people he claimed he would "fight against and win." And he's doing so with justifications so bizarre they defy comprehension. If you 're finding value in this article, please consider becoming a free or paid subscriber. Schumer Thinks Capitulation is a Strategy--It's Not. It's Failure. What is Schumer's justification to vote with Republicans now? He claims kicking the can down the road is the right move because, "Trump will be unpopular in six months, and then Republicans will be forced to negotiate in good faith." Really? Maybe Schumer needs a reminder of the past 4 years alone. Trump was convicted of tax fraud. His company was found liable for decades of corruption. It did not diminish his popularity. Trump incited an insurrection. He tried to overthrow the U.S. government. He then pardoned the white supremacists and Nazis (including the guy who wore the grotesquely antisemitic "Camp Auschwitz" shirt). It did not diminish his popularity. Trump was found liable for sexual assault. A judge and jury in a civil trial ruled him a rapist as per the textbook definition of the word. It did not diminish his popularity. Oh, and he's absolutely pro Nazi salutes, viciously antisemitic, Islamophobic, racist, and misogynistic, and overtly xenophobic against non-white immigrants. Even right now with the stock market crashing, a global trade war rising, and inflation and unemployment increasing, Trump is still more popular than Democrats and certainly more popular than Chuck Schumer. Given all of the above, why on earth does Schumer think that giving Trump even more time, more money, and more power is the right move? This isn't just betrayal. It's utter incompetence. Charlie Schumer is Charlie Brown, the Republicans are Lisa, the football is the GOP's faux deal, and Chuck is yet again falling for it. It's become painfully routine, and the American people are paying the price. | | ---|---|--- And ultimately here's the point that Schumer seems to think the American people don't realize. By voting with Republicans, he is handing Trump and Musk a budget bill with no limit on where and how they can spend funds. On what planet is giving trillions of dollars to two unaccountable billionaires a good idea? It is absolute lunacy. The Democratic Party Has a Choice: Fight, or Step Aside Finally, for those alleging Schumer doesn't speak for the party, let's be clear: 1. Schumer is literally the Democratic Senate Leader. His actions define the party. 2. If Senate Democrats truly found this betrayal objectionable, they'd remove him. They won't. They are complicit. It is both uncomfortable and wholly necessary to acknowledge this fact. We don't need more politicians holding tiny signs and coordinating outfits while Trump consolidates power and enables fascism. We need leadership with the courage to fight injustice and hold the line when it matters. But until that happens, we as voters are not helpless and we cannot give up. We can still raise our voices and demand action and accountability. I encourage each person reading this to not only call each of the above Senate Democrats, but also share this piece with your network and encourage them to call as well. And if you're near Schumer's office, pay him a visit as the young people below are this morning. Schumer may have surrendered, but we still have power. Let's use it. | | ---|---|--- Young people are sitting in at Senator Schumer's office to demand he stop the GOP's corrupt budget. Photo Credit: Sunrise Movement Conclusion Over the past month I've received thousands of message from lifelong Democrats saying the Democratic Party's capitulation and weakness in the face of Trump has convinced them to leave the party altogether. People are fed up with cowardice, and Democratic Party still refuses to listen. | | ---|---|--- History will remember Mitch McConnell and Charlie ~~Brown~~ Schumer as the two US Senators most effective in getting things done for the Republican Party. And that's the fundamental problem. It's clear that whatever the outcome of this budget fight, Chuck Schumer is not the person to lead the Democratic Party. He should resign, and Senate Democrats should elect a new Senate leader--one who will not bow to Trump's fascism, and one who will actually fight for America's working people. Otherwise, the Democratic Party will continue to bleed supporters, and continue to lose to fascists. The American people are exhausted. We cannot afford another moment of weakness. The time for excuses is over. Fight, step aside, or be replaced. The fight to stave off fascism under this new regime is growing. I cannot do it alone. Subscribe below and join the movement. | | ---|---|--- Quick Ask! I am doing everything in my power over the next four years to stave off fascism in the United States, and I need your support.Become a paid subscriber and join the movement.** | | | | | | | (C) 2025 Qasim Rashid, Esq. 1552 South Route 59 #1333 Naperville, IL 60564 ? ?

name: Team DNC
subject: Three things you can do today
body:
---
Derek — Over and over again, Trump has shown that he’ll put his own interests and those of his billionaire backers ahead of everyone else’s — no matter the cost. From announcing harmful executive orders to supporting a tax break for billionaires, he will not stop. **But neither will we.** It’s going to take the full backing of this grassroots team to protect our friends and neighbors from Trump’s destructive, power-hungry grabs. **_Here are three things you can do right now to help:**_
1. If you haven’t already, take a few minutes to [share your feedback](https://ak.democrats.org/signup/share-your-feedback-2025/?refcode=em_20250314_2965_fr&t=2&akid=2975%2E22930333%2EIOb7eF) about where the DNC goes from here.
2. If you have a Republican senator, [call them and tell them to say NO to the Trump tax scam.](http://ak.democrats.org/go/14341?refcode=em_20250314_2965_fr&t=3&akid=2975%2E22930333%2EIOb7eF)
3. [Donate to support the DNC](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-march-2025/?refcode=em_20250314_2965_fr&amount=3&refcode2=2975_22930333_IOb7eF&akid=2975%2E22930333%2EIOb7eF) as we work to win upcoming elections in states like Florida and Wisconsin.

**[SUBMIT FEEDBACK](https://ak.democrats.org/signup/share-your-feedback-2025/?refcode=em_20250314_2965_fr&t=4&akid=2975%2E22930333%2EIOb7eF)** **[CALL YOUR SENATOR](http://ak.democrats.org/go/14341?refcode=em_20250314_2965_fr&t=5&akid=2975%2E22930333%2EIOb7eF)** **[DONATE $3 TODAY](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-march-2025/?refcode=em_20250314_2965_fr&amount=3&refcode2=2975_22930333_IOb7eF&akid=2975%2E22930333%2EIOb7eF)** Thank you for all you do, The Democrats

body:
Trump and the GOP want to take crucial benefits away from working class Americans so they can fund their far-right agenda
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1537%2E791427%2E4qygQA)

Friend — There’s been a lot of talk about Medicaid in the last few weeks, so I thought it would be good to set the record straight with three quick facts.
**FACT:** Medicaid is a highly successful program that has kept millions out of extreme poverty, with 1 in 5 Americans currently receiving Medicaid coverage.
**FACT:** Polling shows that an overwhelming, bipartisan majority of Americans support Medicaid, and over 80% say they don’t want to see **_any**_ cuts to the program.
**FACT:** The Republicans in control of Congress are currently pushing through a spending plan that would severely cut Medicaid funding and leave millions without the life-saving healthcare they rely on.
Friend, it’s simple really. Trump and the GOP want to take crucial benefits away from working class Americans so they can fund their far-right agenda and pass more tax cuts for the super-rich. It’s just the facts.
I am doing what I can to oppose this plan in Congress, and I hope I can count on your support. It will take grassroots action to stop this plan in its tracks.

There are moments when you have to cowboy up, stiffen your spine, and do the tough thing. This is one of those moments, and I am not going to back down.
#

Peter, it’s Ruben.
I’ve been a fighter my whole life.
Had to fight to make ends meet for my family as a kid.
Had to fight to get into Harvard with no money and no connections.
Had to fight to survive Iraq as a Marine.
Had to fight for the care my brothers and I needed from the VA.
Had to fight to get into Congress, and then the Senate.
I did not come all this way to give up as Republicans in Congress decide to hand the reins over to Donald Trump, Elon Musk, and a bunch of grifters who want to destroy services that millions of people depend on.
There are moments when you have to cowboy up, stiffen your spine, and do the tough thing. This is one of those moments, and I am not going to back down. Arizona sent me to the Senate to fight for them, and that is what I am going to do.
Today, I’m going to vote against this terrible budget. Next, I’m going to do town halls in the reddest parts of Arizona to take the fight to Trump and Musk on their home turf. No matter what comes after that, I’m going to need your help.

subject: We must confront this destructive ideology
body:
Please see a special message from our sponsor:

Unsubscribe
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xul=2qq8ny363wdaxf3eu1ztoj1l9emhlf4botx0p8qrkouecg0ulcvhepvhnmtzrm2hrk3c3uaboujfy0rn2bdc1zeu93voh0jzdwtb6dg5p&__stmp=st4f1s&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh

Please see a special message from our sponsor:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st4f1s&__onlt=t

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6dfrls1ta8sqeho0qdfsp5zax3wa63p9uf6qhkotoes07kbr407n9dlpbws7lwpxpsuf3dcsobwb0kfjpmrm7gwn7195rictpvoqq98gujz2wp5m9zvyxnugrcxg39nssz4wu0hy9klrdjujp46xt&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st4f1s&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st4f1s&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st4f1s&__onlt=t

NO
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st4f1s&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6dfrls1ta8sqeho0qdfsp5zaxp7cyn57px3ynzuglkey2f051cqkrkug7clnb0l0rorhre9i7e8vomjz83wq3t6wjc5kqfaeps3993ch5m342a2lsbsc7kusbrv40c500lq9gfo99g15tr80a1h1p&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st4f1s&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st4f1s&__onlt=t

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

# Disability Justice: #TDIH The Capitol Crawl
---
This powerful [post](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMWn3R7U15hZOprFI75oZg47Fg2X12YodLl9v032gpfdGMFzNlYEAsD_LxPGT_oyjprY59WUXMMZzOiNP5C1wdzKDYO68Yiof9RC2iPgNw9d6fKsxhpSbc-f3mkfQHJvGuqtnoN-3P8HfytFPlh28t1PavOBUtQqwXe78gWDVgkYk09RxMuyjsMOb288XH-womEW8IXqbDvn4DFU7DaEF1qdHnq3n0f1EExI_p9bzn31sqTgaRSlAou0QenMyDvH1u9yeCdm_SxwzDafKiqo2MjOHcy0Xr2986z9WeTa4aR65/4es/BET-1whRS7-G35r_hJzpWQ/h5/h001.oJD5SArk9SGew9n7d_vXTJwDImghZqugPKhxhFeb9uY) by Working Class History highlights a pivotal action to get the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) passed. "**On March 12, 1990, dozens of disabled people descended on the US Capitol and carried out a protest which became known as the Capitol Crawl.** Participants were protesting against the stalling of a proposed law, the ADA, which would prohibit discrimination against disabled people. Around 1,000 other protesters watched and cheered while dozens of members of ADAPT, a group campaigning for public transit access for disabled people, **abandoned their wheelchairs and mobility aids and began crawling up the steps of the building housing Congress.**
---
|
---
Michael Winter, one of the participants later reflected:** 'Some people may have thought it was undignified for people in wheelchairs to crawl in that manner, but I felt that it was necessary to show the country what kinds of things people with disabilities have to face on a day-to-day basis. We had to be willing to fight for what we believed in.'"** The direct action protest forced Congress to respond and the ADA bill passed through the House and Senate and was signed into law on July 26, 1990.

clean_body: Funding billionaire tax cuts: Nothing is safe | | For billionaire tax cuts is there anyone Trump won't sell out? We knew Trump, Musk, and their administration were coming to destroy everything and everyone, and this week education was in the crosshairs. In a single day the Trump Administration in the name of efficiency. It's now only half the size it was at the start of 2025. They might not legally be allowed to dissolve it, but they're doing their best to make it functionally dead. High quality, federally funded public education for all is essential to a strong future of our country. MAGA republicans would rather fund tax cuts for billionaires than care about our kids. | Repro Roundup It seems like with every piece of good news, there's something challenging that follows it up. So, we'll start with the good: -- Arizona's 15-week abortion ban is now 'permanently and forever' struck down! "Doctors and women now have the final say about when an abortion should be performed, after a Maricopa County Superior Court judge struck down the state's 15-week ban following last year's vote to enshrine abortion rights in the Arizona Constitution." Now, the news that makes us go WTF: A Louisiana parent has been for obtaining abortion pills for her daughter, AND in what might be the first cross-state charges , the New York doctor has been charged as well. New York Gov. Kathy Hochul is steadfast in her refusal to extradite the doctor, citing NY's . And, this past Monday was Abortion Provider Appreciation Day! A day to honor Dr. David Gunn who was murdered by an anti-abortion extremist in 1993 for providing abortion care. We also celebrate all abortion providers for your dedication and perseverance in the face of a world of challenges. You are the shining lights in our orbit! | Disability Justice: #TDIH The Capitol Crawl This powerful by Working Class History highlights a pivotal action to get the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) passed. "On March 12, 1990, dozens of disabled people descended on the US Capitol and carried out a protest which became known as the Capitol Crawl. Participants were protesting against the stalling of a proposed law, the ADA, which would prohibit discrimination against disabled people. Around 1,000 other protesters watched and cheered while dozens of members of ADAPT, a group campaigning for public transit access for disabled people, abandoned their wheelchairs and mobility aids and began crawling up the steps of the building housing Congress. | Michael Winter, one of the participants later reflected: 'Some people may have thought it was undignified for people in wheelchairs to crawl in that manner, but I felt that it was necessary to show the country what kinds of things people with disabilities have to face on a day-to-day basis. We had to be willing to fight for what we believed in.'" The direct action protest forced Congress to respond and the ADA bill passed through the House and Senate and was signed into law on July 26, 1990. subject: Cowardly Tactics from the GOP

body:
Republican leaders are now advising their lawmakers to avoid town halls—dodging the very people they claim to represent. They don’t want to face the tough questions. They don’t want to be held accountable. And they certainly don’t want to explain why they keep putting their own interests ahead of yours. | Hello Peter,**have you seen the latest?**

[_**Republican leaders are now advising their lawmakers to _avoid_ town halls**_](https://fight4progress.org/valimont?t=RHEdhjN4LJbc&refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2025-03-13_1&amount=25)— _dodging_ the very people they claim to represent. They don’t want to face the tough questions. They don’t want to be held accountable. And they certainly don’t want to explain why they keep putting their own interests ahead of yours.

**This is not leadership. This is cowardice.

[_And it is up to us to stop it._](https://fight4progress.org/valimont?t=3JI5NhtOaoAC&refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2025-03-13_1&amount=25)**
---
[](https://fight4progress.org/valimont?t=hJMGf11ed5ZA&refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2025-03-13_1&amount=25)
**I believe in something different.** Over the past few weeks, I’ve been showing up—everywhere. At the 3rd Annual Community Prayer Breakfast, talking with local leaders. At Tranquil Villas, hearing from our seniors over coffee. At the Walton County NAACP Freedom Fund Dinner, celebrating progress and discussing the work ahead. At protests, meeting families who just want a better future for their kids.

I’m here because _**this is my job**_ —to listen, to show up, and to fight for you.

**With just 19 days until the special election, we have to make a choice:** Do we want more representatives who hide from the people they serve? Or do we elect leaders who will stand in front of their communities and _answer to them?_

[_**I’m ready to be that leader.**_](https://fight4progress.org/valimont?t=PXzTHyZTFBoo&refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2025-03-13_1&amount=25)

[_**But I need your help. I’ve missed my February goal by $1,500, and if that is not met today, I will stall out. Help me restore leadership to Northwest Florida. Can you split a donation between my campaign and Fight for Progress right now?**_](https://fight4progress.org/valimont?t=emf4dYlTDMs6&refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2025-03-13_1&amount=25)
[](https://fight4progress.org/valimont?t=4ljBpgxK8qpb&refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2025-03-13_1&amount=25)
**Join in the fight for thousands to feel proud to be Floridian and American.**

Thank you,
Gay Valimont
Candidate for Congress, FL-1

name: Kirk Cameron
subject: Drag queen pride parades on Blue’s Clues are unacceptable
body:
You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.| | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friend in Faith, Please -- for the sake of all our families -- take it from me as someone who's lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life...You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace. But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue's Clues_...
---
[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=52b972a37e624d9eabb98f405cabd2f1&_e=u8YxPakbFwnwdlpPf52NDgL8dgWLRA3AIMpAAjP8YkTLVRLmoaOuHVNqjMtR8pk8W8M09m8WmLugOmezqrWYAMcRgFLrW9YccLg2spBzODLHFBblkIJ364gWXtE7TxQn2ZXAFukHSR1gSvdElzV01mhd533-6PQeUHNmMl8wNeOv5_vMtszWj3QP_0vlNUKl5tA0b-7SeziFib0dwwOjTwEjE6mhFViUZDT_eppwfi568nZRLLxawKsiyVa7vIaSL2X-IFRTOeZ6-MGvdYEhDtkB1BG9piy198Mn8kK4P3jyTMVPO4kb5hdJQjJno5JeGds6yOQ09HuU2aTkx3tMHFQSAi2bRopEDebIOSXOCChmNvUWz5gpvcbIIYGO7aIW)
---
| | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to "educate" YOU about your "old-fashioned" and "mean" ideas.Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. [**Today, I'm inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children’s television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great**.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=52b972a37e624d9eabb98f405cabd2f1&_e=u8YxPakbFwnwdlpPf52NDgL8dgWLRA3AIMpAAjP8YkTLVRLmoaOuHVNqjMtR8pk8W8M09m8WmLugOmezqrWYAMcRgFLrW9YccLg2spBzODLHFBblkIJ364gWXtE7TxQn2ZXAFukHSR1gSvdElzV01mhd533-6PQeUHNmMl8wNeOv5_vMtszWj3QP_0vlNUKl5tA0b-7SeziFib0dwwOjTwEjE6mhFViUZDT_eppwfi5W3xcpbyjdvXOmyQjpphKZPSAUSiwYmLgaomWtnamzR2JHpUh_4_x556Hp79cKKD6yJxtXJftTS1z2A42WQIV-c9zyqTnhXcXjEkeBmO_wfFNwuPR1BZtOr5WWyCjsmdPGdQfDjsq-8WBvo3QGibdj)Introducing: _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.I'm making this ground-breaking live-action television show with the great folks at **Brave Books**.If you've seen me and **Brave Books** on _Fox News_ , you know we've already countered those awful "Drag Queen Story Hours" the Left has been pushing on children in our taxpayer funded libraries. Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic "Story Hours" of our own.And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries.It's encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we're working to have that same impact in television.
---
>>Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth.Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. >> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart.>> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.
---
The great news is that we've already completed the first ten character-building episodes of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_!We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces.And I wish you could have experienced _the parents_ watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages.It was quite a moment for everyone -- including folks just like you -- who worked so hard to get us that far.But now **Brave Books** has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with.
---
_**#1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left.**_
---
You see, we're making the first 5 episodes of Season 1 of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ available absolutely FREE to everyone on YouTube. That's the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging.But no one will see it if we can't get the word out. And the left will try to bury _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 -- and we need to raise the funds in this first quarter of 2025.
---
_**#2. We must complete Season 2 to keep our momentum going and that cost is $125,000 per episode.**_
---
I know that's a lot of money but it's actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. And obviously, we won't work through Hollywood.Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children.We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens _must take over_ to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture. **[That's why I'm asking you to please contribute $35, $50, $250, $500, $2,500 or more to help us reach our fundraising goal of $250,000 for advertising and $125,000 per episode for Season 2.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=52b972a37e624d9eabb98f405cabd2f1&_e=u8YxPakbFwnwdlpPf52NDgL8dgWLRA3AIMpAAjP8YkTLVRLmoaOuHVNqjMtR8pk8W8M09m8WmLugOmezqrWYAMcRgFLrW9YccLg2spBzODLHFBblkIJ364gWXtE7TxQn2ZXAFukHSR1gSvdElzV01mhd533-6PQeUHNmMl8wNeOv5_vMtszWj3QP_0vlNUKl5tA0b-7SeziFib0dwwOjTwEjE6mhFViUZDT_eppwfi5b27i6CKIIKzihDanqZWSQ9-NVLBl-ZAJm4-9PT81rRTO3d2SIjGri6sHHrCPS8u8OHdIecugWP2PSsN6Imgw2i5njI9hzixSwOyti8f4klYLPDIxFZpUHUM7LYHryu_oJGyJh162Gy1i15m_q6RJr) ** As our special "Thank You" for becoming a **Founding Supporter** at the $50 level, we'll send you all ten episodes of Season 1 of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ _FREE on DVD_.This exclusive _Adventure with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ DVD is only offered to **Founding Supporters**. It won't be available for sale anywhere. So with **[**your gift of $50**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=52b972a37e624d9eabb98f405cabd2f1&_e=u8YxPakbFwnwdlpPf52NDgL8dgWLRA3AIMpAAjP8YkTLVRLmoaOuHVNqjMtR8pk8W8M09m8WmLugOmezqrWYAMcRgFLrW9YccLg2spBzODLHFBblkIJ364gWXtE7TxQn2ZXAFukHSR1gSvdElzV01mhd533-6PQeUHNmMl8wNeOv5_vMtszWj3QP_0vlNUKl5tA0b-7SeziFib0dwwOjTwEjE6mhFViUZDT_eppwfi4kAugFCNT3HK3Vhdqt-VuBC4yY_nMQokvgzyq4n7MbDxu8x4JOe8tW5Oe5ASHXNJd_5BEPDAhhxFz7zRjNV8GE5qwuws0zxAslr2WBrxJodZto9npBYbzNEOmY6ejzcJ18zCfr_Jgm39gzM4RYCzOo)** , you'll be part of a select group of people who own our wholesome TV show on DVD. You'll have it ready to watch with the children in your life. Or you can drop your DVD by your local school, church, mission, or even leave it in the waiting room at your doctor's office. So many children have no way of hearing God's message in their lives. Your random act of kindness may change a child's life. **[**So please -- whether you can send $50, $5,000, $25,000, or anything higher or lower, please respond quickly and know that gifts of EVERY size are needed and greatly appreciated.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=52b972a37e624d9eabb98f405cabd2f1&_e=u8YxPakbFwnwdlpPf52NDgL8dgWLRA3AIMpAAjP8YkTLVRLmoaOuHVNqjMtR8pk8W8M09m8WmLugOmezqrWYAMcRgFLrW9YccLg2spBzODLHFBblkIJ364gWXtE7TxQn2ZXAFukHSR1gSvdElzV01mhd533-6PQeUHNmMl8wNeOv5_vMtszWj3QP_0vlNUKl5tA0b-7SeziFib0dwwOjTwEjE6mhFViUZDT_eppwfi4s4c_7eUCkRvBhkkwCc96lyCgMwJv6jsQXQvBug13w9YuIBI1V8J3SmRfAOSpl3o0WPwXV9477PKIckEiYW4pzJl9Caz1EuAmw-Y9JXULwPEwJnQ5Kg2J2_uhU9xf0AKXMS4FFvnGZjuXdTMm5mM5Y)** There's no time to waste. Hollywood groomers have destroyed America's Godly culture. But today we rebuild from the ashes.And it starts by ensuring the most innocent among us are filled with faith and family -- not filth.Thank you for being a part of history by becoming a **Founding Supporter** of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.

Sincerely,

body:
I want to share more about what we learned in my last race and why we now have an even stronger path to unseating Derrick Van Orden.
**Peter, I just announced my campaign for Congress in Wisconsin's 3rd District.**
I want to share more about what we learned in my last race and why we now have an even stronger path to unseating Derrick Van Orden. But first, we set an ambitious goal of reaching 2,026 Founding Donors to start this campaign with strength.
**[Can you split a donation of $10 with Heartland Patriots today? Every contribution can be the difference in our fight to reclaim rural districts and retake the House.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/87001?refcode=em20250314-8820&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=8820%2E614464%2E5wlBT_)**
**[DONATE](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/87001?refcode=em20250314-8820&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=8820%2E614464%2E5wlBT_)**
So, why am I running again?
Because working class Wisconsinites deserve a voice in Congress -- someone who knows what it’s like to work for a living. And we’ve proven we can make real inroads when we show up, listen, and focus on issues that matter: good jobs, affordable health care, and lowering costs for working families.
In an election year that saw many voters frustrated with the national Democratic Party, we still outperformed the US Senator Tammy Baldwin by 5,000 votes in this district. We even out-paced Kamala Harris by 9,000 votes.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/87001?refcode=em20250314-8820&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=8820%2E614464%2E5wlBT_)
**Peter, we won more votes than any Democrat in WI-03 in nearly a decade.**
It’s clear we’re on to something, but winning back rural, working-class voters takes time. And the tough truth is that Democrats lost these voters' trust over years of neglect. It won’t be rebuilt overnight, but we know progress is possible if we show up and keep fighting.
**I’m running because our work _has_ to continue.**
We’re on month three of complete far right control in Washington, and folks are learning in real time that taking a buzz saw to the government won’t lower the price of eggs, or the cost of gas in your car.
These are the voters we need to win over, we won't take any voter for granted or write anyone off who is starting from a different viewpoint. That's how we've done things for generations in Wisconsin, and that’s why we’ll finish the job and unseat Derrick Van Orden this time around.
**[Flipping this seat is going to take widespread, local support -- and I’d be humbled to have you on board. If you can, please split a donation of $10 with Heartland Patriots to become a Founding Donor of my 2026 campaign.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/87001?refcode=em20250314-8820&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=8820%2E614464%2E5wlBT_)**

**Oregon House Recognizes Oregon Farmer and Rancher Day**
_Tuesday, March 11, 2025_
Salem, OR — Today, the Oregon House of Representatives passed [House Bill 3141-A](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Folis.oregonlegislature.gov%2Fliz%2F2025R1%2FMeasures%2FOverview%2FHB3141/1/0101019595898108-aa5e79a8-a05d-4f22-b5f5-b7ec30e61265-000000/A5JrluXq90PIMeJ1i6T_2lEygqG8JrjO5I_3M5tIXIU=396) on a vote of 57-1. The bill sets aside the third Tuesday in March of each year, recognizing it as Oregon Farmer and Rancher Day.
“Border to border and corner to corner, Oregon is diverse in landscapes, rich in agricultural heritage, and includes vibrant rural communities. Our farmers and ranchers are the backbone of our great state. They helped to build our state into statehood, work to feed our local communities and show up when communities are in need. Despite their crucial role, the sacrifices and struggles of these individuals often go unnoticed.” Said Rep. Breese Iverson (R-Prineville)
The third Tuesday in March is also National Ag Day which creates the opportunity for further recognition and synergy in highlighting the contributions of Oregon’s farmers and ranchers. HB 3141-A moves to the Senate for consideration.
Rep. Vikki Breese Iverson represents House District 59 which includes Crook County and parts of Deschutes and Jefferson counties.
